title: Social Media Creator
description:
WE’RE HIRING: CONTENT CREATOR



We’re looking for a creative and reliable Content Creator to join our growing jewelry brand.



Your role will be focused 100% on content creation — you won’t need to publish posts, manage accounts, reply to comments, or handle our social media strategy. We take care of all publishing and account management.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Create daily content for our social media channels:



• 2-3 Instagram Reels per day

• Around 10-15 TikTok carousel posts per day

• Create engaging, aesthetic and attention-grabbing content based on our products, brand identity and creative directions

• Develop different hooks, concepts and content angles to continuously test new ideas



We will provide the necessary product materials, photos, videos and brand references.



WORKING HOURS



There are no fixed working hours.



We are looking for someone who can dedicate approximately 2–4 hours per day to content creation.



You can organize your working time however you prefer — what matters to us is consistency, creativity and delivering the agreed content.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Someone who:



• Understands TikTok and Instagram content

• Knows how to create engaging short-form videos and carousel posts

• Has a good eye for aesthetics and visual storytelling

• Understands hooks, trends and what makes people stop scrolling

• Is comfortable using tools such as Canva, CapCut or similar

• Can work independently and consistently

• Is willing to test new ideas and creative formats



Experience with fashion, jewelry, beauty or e-commerce brands is a plus.



TO APPLY



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Examples of content you have created

3. Your previous experience, if any

4. The tools you normally use for content creation

5. Your expected monthly salary/rate



**IMPORTANT:** To confirm that you have read the entire job post, please start your application with the word  “Mare”



**Applications that do not include the word “Mare” will not be considered.**



We’re looking for someone interested in a **long-term collaboration** who can grow creatively together with our brand. 🌊

Search for vehicle importers, car dealers, automotive trading companies, brokers, distributors, and other automotive businesses.

Company name

Website

 address

Strong internet research skills

Ability to work effectively with Google, Instagram, LinkedIn,
, and business directories

Excellent attention to detail

Good Excel or Google Sheets skills

Strong organizational skills

Good English, sufficient for researching international companies and websites

Experience in Lead Generation, Market Research, or B2B Research is an advantage

Experience or knowledge of the automotive industry is a strong advantage

What Is Most Important to Us



Quality is more important than quantity.



We are not looking for a database containing hundreds of random automotive companies.



We need real vehicle importers, dealers, distributors, and trading companies that could potentially purchase vehicles from South Korea and Japan.

We are a small technology solutions company in the USA offering private cloud hosting, enterprise software readiness and deployment, managed IT services, AI integrations, and SaaS services.



WE INVEST IN YOU:

We hire with the intent that you would become part of our team for the long-term. We are a very small company with a fairly fast-paced environment and can offer incredible opportunity for career growth in tech and access to learn about the newest technologies, private cloud and AI.

Our audience is Americans….. So you would need to have EXCELLENT spoken English skills (without a discernable accent), plus very good written/grammar skills.

title: E-Commerce QA & Implementation Specialist (Associate Level)
description:
About the Role

I am looking for an E-Commerce QA & Implementation Specialist (Associate Level) to support my growing operations. This is a full-time position with dedicated hours.



In this role, you will be my primary line of defense for quality—testing a merchant-facing e-commerce application that integrates directly with Shopify stores. You will review user experiences, validate bug fixes, and ensure design, functional, and responsive accuracy across mobile and desktop before anything goes live. You will also assist with app configurations, basic code tweaks, and day-to-day client support tickets.



I need someone with real-world experience who understands web app testing and front-end troubleshooting, and who can take ownership without needing step-by-step hand-holding.





Key Responsibilities

*Application & Integration Testing: Thoroughly test core app functionality, user interfaces, responsive layouts, and edge-case workflows as they appear on live e-commerce storefronts.



*Troubleshooting & Bug Reporting: Use Chrome DevTools to inspect front-end issues, isolate script or visual bugs, and log detailed reports with clear reproduction steps for our developers.



*App Setup & Site Tweaks: Perform app settings configurations for merchants and make basic HTML/CSS adjustments when needed.



*Direct Support: Collaborate directly with me, our development team, and support channels to verify technical fixes and keep client tickets moving smoothly.





Requirements



*Track Record: Minimum 1 year of direct, professional work experience in web QA, technical web support, or web application testing.



*E-Commerce Familiarity: Understanding of how e-commerce storefronts work (particularly Shopify environments).



*Technical Proficiency: Demonstrated, hands-on ability with HTML & CSS to inspect, troubleshoot, and apply minor front-end fixes.



*Testing Tools: Practical experience using browser inspection tools (e.g., Chrome DevTools) to debug front-end issues, network activity, or visual defects.



*Workflow Tools: Active experience managing tickets and issues within platforms like Jira, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or HubSpot.



*Communication: Exceptional written English for drafting detailed, developer-ready bug reports.



Preferred Experience



*Familiarity with basic JavaScript or executing A/B testing variations.





Application Instructions

To apply, submit a message with the following details:



Subject Line: ASSOCIATE



Resume: Direct link to your updated resume detailing past client or agency employment.



Cover Letter: A summary of your 1–3 years of hands-on QA/testing experience.



Note: Incomplete applications will not be evaluated.

title: SENIOR ARCHITECTURAL DESIGNER
description:
# SENIOR ARCHITECTURAL DESIGNER – LUXURY RESIDENTIAL & BIM COORDINATION



**Remote Position — Philippines**

**U.S.-Based Development / Construction / Engineering Company**



We are seeking an exceptional **Senior Architectural Designer** with strong experience in **high-end residential architecture, custom homes, luxury interiors, architectural detailing, Revit/BIM, AutoCAD, and multidisciplinary construction coordination**.



This is **not a basic drafting position**.



We are looking for someone who can take an architectural concept and develop it into a sophisticated, buildable, coordinated design.



The ideal candidate understands both sides of architecture:



**Design excellence + construction reality.**



You should be able to create beautiful spaces while simultaneously considering structural systems, mechanical equipment, plumbing, electrical, lighting, ceiling conditions, cabinetry, waterproofing, drainage, accessibility, constructability, and actual field installation.



## WHAT YOU WILL DESIGN



Projects may include:



* Luxury custom residences

* High-end renovations

* Estate homes

* Modern residential architecture

* Commercial spaces

* Offices

* Specialty structures

* Outdoor living areas

* Pools and spas

* High-end kitchens

* Primary suites

* Custom bathrooms

* Theaters

* Entertainment spaces

* Specialty rooms

* Architectural staircases

* Double-height spaces

* Custom millwork

* Exterior architectural features

* Landscape-integrated architecture

* Complex below-grade and concrete structures



We want someone capable of designing architecture that feels **intentional, premium, timeless, technically sophisticated, and fully coordinated.**



---



# PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



You will assist with architecture from early concept development through detailed construction documents.



Responsibilities include:



* Develop architectural concepts from owner/project requirements.

* Produce floor plans, reflected ceiling plans, elevations, sections, wall sections, and architectural details.

* Prepare complete architectural construction-document packages.

* Develop designs using **Revit and AutoCAD**.

* Create and maintain coordinated BIM models.

* Develop sophisticated space-planning solutions.

* Design architectural circulation and room relationships.

* Develop building massing and exterior elevations.

* Design custom architectural features.

* Coordinate finish materials and transitions.

* Develop ceiling designs and lighting integration.

* Coordinate architectural elements with structural and MEP systems.

* Coordinate doors, windows, openings, stairs, millwork, cabinetry, equipment, and fixtures.

* Develop enlarged plans for kitchens, bathrooms, specialty rooms, and complex architectural areas.

* Develop architectural details that can actually be constructed.

* Produce presentation drawings and design-development packages.

* Create or coordinate high-quality architectural renderings.

* Review plans for constructability.

* Review contractor and consultant drawings for conflicts.

* Develop RFIs and coordination questions when required.

* Incorporate field conditions and design revisions into drawings.

* Maintain proper drawing revision control.



---



# HIGH-END DESIGN EXPECTATIONS



We are specifically looking for someone with strong architectural judgment.



You should understand:



* Scale

* Proportion

* Symmetry

* Asymmetrical balance

* Visual hierarchy

* Sight lines

* Spatial sequencing

* Natural light

* Artificial lighting

* Ceiling heights

* Material transitions

* Architectural rhythm

* Exterior massing

* Façade composition

* Indoor/outdoor relationships

* Furniture planning

* Circulation

* Privacy

* Acoustics

* Human experience within a space



You should be capable of designing a room beyond simply placing four walls around it.



For example, when designing a luxury great room, you should be thinking about:



* Entry sight line

* Window placement

* Ceiling architecture

* Structural column locations

* Furniture arrangement

* Fireplace proportions

* Lighting

* HVAC diffusers

* Speaker placement

* Electrical outlets

* AV systems

* Artwork locations

* Chandelier position

* Exterior views

* Door relationships

* Material transitions



Everything should feel coordinated.



---



# BIM / CAD REQUIREMENTS



Strong proficiency is expected in:



* **Autodesk Revit**

* **AutoCAD**

* PDF review and markup software such as Bluebeam Revu



Experience with the following is highly preferred:



* Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360

* Navisworks

* SketchUp

* Enscape

* Lumion

* Twinmotion

* V-Ray

* 3ds Max

* Rhino

* Photoshop

* Illustrator

* InDesign



You do not need to know every program listed.



However, you must be highly capable with professional architectural drafting and BIM workflows.



---



# ARCHITECTURAL VISUALIZATION



Strong visualization skills are highly valued.



Candidates with experience producing:



* Photorealistic architectural renderings

* Exterior renderings

* Interior renderings

* Material studies

* Lighting studies

* Walkthroughs

* Architectural animations

* Concept presentations



will receive strong consideration.



Rendering quality should support **high-end architectural presentation**, not basic conceptual modeling.



---



# STRUCTURAL COORDINATION



You must understand enough structural design to recognize when architecture conflicts with the structure.



You should be able to coordinate architectural plans with:



* Structural columns

* Concrete walls

* Structural beams

* Steel framing

* Load-bearing walls

* Foundation systems

* Grade beams

* Elevated slabs

* Roof framing

* Shear walls

* Large openings

* Stair openings

* Double-height spaces



You are not expected to replace the structural engineer.



You **are expected to recognize conflicts**.



For example:



If a structural column lands directly in the middle of an important architectural sight line, you should identify the issue during design coordination—not after construction begins.



---



# MEP COORDINATION



You must understand how architecture interacts with:



### HVAC



* Supply diffusers

* Return-air locations

* Duct routing

* Mechanical equipment

* Thermostat locations

* Linear diffusers

* Ceiling coordination



### Plumbing



* Fixture locations

* Drain locations

* Wet-wall alignment

* Plumbing chases

* Vent stacks

* Floor drains

* Roof drains

* Equipment requirements



### Electrical



* Lighting

* Receptacles

* Switch locations

* Electrical panels

* AV equipment

* Lighting controls

* Specialty power requirements



### Low Voltage / Technology



* Speakers

* Cameras

* Data

* Wi-Fi access points

* TVs

* Control panels

* Automation systems



The architectural drawings should not be developed in isolation.



---



# CLASH DETECTION & DESIGN COORDINATION



You should continuously review drawings for conflicts between:



**Architecture + Structure + Mechanical + Electrical + Plumbing + Civil + Interior Design + Landscape**



Examples include:



* Ductwork crossing structural beams

* Plumbing risers conflicting with architectural openings

* Columns interfering with doors

* Ceiling designs conflicting with HVAC equipment

* Light fixtures conflicting with diffusers

* Cabinetry interfering with electrical devices

* Plumbing fixtures lacking adequate wall cavities

* Roof drains interfering with structural framing

* Stair geometry conflicting with required headroom

* Windows conflicting with structural elements

* Mechanical equipment visible from important architectural areas



The goal is to solve these issues **before construction**.



---



# CONSTRUCTION DOCUMENT QUALITY



We expect exceptionally clean architectural drawings.



Before a drawing package is released, you should verify:



* Dimensions

* Room sizes

* Wall locations

* Door locations

* Window locations

* Ceiling heights

* Floor elevations

* Stair geometry

* Section references

* Detail references

* Material transitions

* Structural coordination

* MEP coordination

* Accessibility requirements

* Fixture clearances

* Cabinetry dimensions

* Equipment clearances

* Exterior elevations

* Roof relationships

* Waterproofing conditions

* Drainage conditions

* Constructability



Changes must be coordinated throughout the entire drawing package.



Changing something on one floor plan without updating the affected elevations, sections, structural interfaces, reflected ceiling plans, or details is unacceptable.



---



# U.S. CONSTRUCTION KNOWLEDGE



Experience working on U.S. projects is strongly preferred.



Candidates should have experience with or be capable of learning and applying relevant requirements including:



* International Residential Code

* International Building Code

* Energy-code requirements

* ADA requirements where applicable

* Life-safety requirements

* Means of egress

* Stair requirements

* Guard and handrail requirements

* Minimum room and clearance requirements

* Fire separation requirements

* U.S. construction-document conventions



Local jurisdiction requirements will vary by project.



---



# REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Bachelor's degree in Architecture or a closely related field.

* Strong architectural-design portfolio.

* Strong Revit experience.

* Strong AutoCAD experience.

* Strong understanding of architectural construction drawings.

* Experience developing construction-document packages.

* Ability to read structural and MEP drawings.

* Strong understanding of architectural detailing.

* Strong spatial-design ability.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Excellent written English communication.

* Ability to receive design direction and intelligently develop it.

* Ability to work independently.

* Ability to manage multiple revisions without losing drawing coordination.

* Reliable workstation and high-speed internet connection.



---



# HIGHLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Preference will be given to candidates with experience in:



* Luxury residential architecture

* Custom homes

* Estate homes

* High-end interiors

* Modern architecture

* Revit BIM modeling

* U.S. construction projects

* Design-build construction

* Construction administration

* Structural coordination

* MEP coordination

* Custom millwork

* Detailed kitchen and bathroom design

* Architectural lighting coordination

* Complex reinforced-concrete projects

* Pools and spas

* Outdoor living environments

* Specialty architectural spaces

* High-end architectural visualization



---



# WHO WE DO NOT WANT



We are not looking for someone whose primary skill is simply tracing drawings or following redlines.



We do not want:



* A basic CAD operator

* Someone who only creates conceptual renderings

* Someone who designs without understanding construction

* Someone who ignores structural or MEP conflicts

* Someone who requires every architectural decision to be explained step-by-step

* Someone who changes one drawing without coordinating the rest of the project



We need someone who can **think architecturally and technically.**



---



# WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



When you review a design, your thought process should include questions such as:



**Does this look exceptional?**



**Does the space feel properly proportioned?**



**How will this actually be constructed?**



**Where is the structure?**



**Where are the ducts?**



**Where does the plumbing run?**



**Where are the electrical panels and controls?**



**Will the lighting layout remain architecturally clean?**



**Are the ceiling conditions coordinated?**



**Can the contractor build what is shown?**



**Are there conflicts that nobody else has identified yet?**



That level of thinking is what we expect.



---



# REMOTE WORKING RELATIONSHIP



This is a remote Philippines-based position supporting a U.S. development, engineering, and construction organization.



You may work directly with:



* Ownership

* Project management

* Structural engineering

* MEP engineering

* Construction superintendents

* Subcontractors

* Vendors

* Interior designers

* Consultants



Some working-hour overlap with **U.S. Central Time** will be required for project coordination.



For the right candidate, this can become a long-term position with increasing responsibility for architectural design, BIM standards, quality control, and design leadership.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



1. Resume/CV.

2. Architectural portfolio.

3. Examples of complete construction drawings you personally developed.

4. Examples of Revit models.

5. Examples of luxury residential or high-end architectural projects.

6. Examples of interior architectural work.

7. Examples of exterior/elevation design.

8. Examples of renderings, if applicable.

9. Years of Revit experience.

10. Years of AutoCAD experience.

11. Description of your experience working with U.S. construction projects.

12. Description of your structural and MEP coordination experience.

13. Software you are proficient in.

14. Current availability.

15. Expected monthly compensation in PHP.

16. Computer/workstation specifications.

17. Internet connection information.



## REQUIRED TECHNICAL DESIGN QUESTION



Include a response to the following scenario:



**You are designing a high-end two-story great room with a large chandelier, full-height windows, architectural ceiling features, concealed HVAC, integrated speakers, and large structural beams. During coordination, you discover that the original HVAC duct route crosses a structural beam and the proposed chandelier location conflicts with structural framing. Explain how you would coordinate the architecture, structure, lighting, mechanical systems, and ceiling design to resolve the conflicts without degrading the architectural intent.**



We want to understand **how you think**, not just what software you know.



---



**Position:** Senior Architectural Designer – Luxury Residential & BIM Coordination

**Location:** Philippines — Remote

**Industry:** Architecture / Development / Engineering / Construction

**Project Focus:** Luxury Residential, Custom Construction & Specialty Projects

**Employment:** Long-term opportunity

description:
NYC Refrigeration Mech Corp is a New York City HVAC and commercial refrigeration contractor serving restaurants, commercial buildings, and residential properties.



We need a dependable Remote HVAC Service Coordinator / Dispatcher to own service requests from the first customer call through technician dispatch, follow-up, and completed work order. This is a live phone and dispatch position—not general data entry.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Answer customer calls and
s professionally.

• Collect complete service information: contact, location, equipment, symptoms, access instructions, urgency, and billing or PO requirements.

• Create clear, accurate work orders.

• Close work orders only when documentation is complete and ready for billing.

• Maintain organized customer and equipment records.

• Provide a daily review of open, completed, and pending jobs.

• Use Google Workspace, Dropbox, and our work-order/dispatch software.



You are not expected to diagnose HVAC equipment. You must ask the right questions, document accurately, avoid unauthorized promises, and escalate issues properly.



REQUIREMENTS

• Proven field-service dispatch, service coordination, or similar phone-based experience.

• Excellent spoken and written English.

• Confident handling urgent and upset customers.

• Strong scheduling judgment, attention to detail, and follow-through.

• Comfortable learning HVAC and refrigeration terminology.

• Reliable computer, quality headset, and quiet professional workspace.

• Reliable primary internet plus backup internet and a practical power-outage plan.

• No other job may overlap this shift.



HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing, electrical, or other field-service experience is strongly preferred. Experience with field-service software, QuickBooks, Google Workspace, or Dropbox is helpful.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

• Philippines-based remote position.

• Full-time, Monday through Friday.

• 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, including a one-hour unpaid break.

• This is normally 8:00 PM–5:00 AM or 9:00 PM–6:00 AM in the Philippines, depending on U.S. daylight-saving time.

• $6–$8 USD per hour, based on relevant experience and demonstrated ability.

• Selected finalists will complete a short paid trial.

• Long-term opportunity for the right person.



HOW TO APPLY

Start both your application subject and first line with: NYC HVAC DISPATCH



Applications missing this phrase or the requested information will not be reviewed.



Include:

1. Your résumé.

2. A 60–90 second voice recording explaining your dispatch experience and how you handled an urgent service call.

3. Numbered answers to all screening questions below.

4. Your earliest start date and requested hourly rate.



SCREENING QUESTIONS

1. Describe your most recent dispatch or service-coordination role, including industry, number of technicians supported, approximate daily call/work-order volume, software used, and exact responsibilities.

2. At 10:15 AM, a restaurant reports its walk-in freezer is at 24°F and product is becoming soft. Every technician is already assigned. Explain exactly what you would do during the first ten minutes. Do not diagnose the equipment.

3. Convert this message into a professional work order and list what information is still needed: “John from Metro Cafe says the back walk-in freezer is 24°F and product feels soft. It started sometime last night. Call Maria before arriving. Use rear entrance.”

4. What must a technician’s completed work order contain before it is ready for billing?

5. Describe your primary internet, backup internet, computer, headset, workspace, and power-outage plan.

6. Confirm your exact availability in U.S. Eastern Time, any overlapping work commitments, earliest start date, and requested hourly rate.

title: Experienced U.S. Credit Repair Specialist / Virtual Assistant
description:
ClearPath Approvals is looking for an experienced U.S. Credit Repair Specialist / Virtual Assistant who already has hands-on experience working with U.S. consumer credit reports.



THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER CREDIT REPAIR POSITION.



We are looking for someone who can think independently, analyze credit reports, recognize factual reporting issues, review bureau responses, and understand when an account should — and should NOT — be disputed.



You will be trained on our proprietary ClearPath Approvals (CPA) operating platform, which we use to organize evidence, dispute workflows, bureau activity, responses, follow-ups, and case progression.



We are not looking to teach credit repair from scratch.



EXPERIENCE WE VALUE:



• Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion credit reports

• Three-bureau credit report analysis

• Collections and charge-offs

• Late-payment reporting

• Account status, balance, date, and payment-history discrepancies

• Hard inquiries

• Duplicate or inconsistent reporting

• Credit bureau disputes

• Reviewing investigation results and bureau responses

• Multiple dispute rounds

• Consumer documentation and evidence

• Method of Verification (MOV) concepts

• CFPB complaint workflows

• Direct furnisher disputes

• FCRA-related credit reporting concepts

• Credit Repair Cloud or similar credit-repair software



You do not need experience with every item above, but real U.S. credit-repair experience is required.



WHAT YOU MAY DO:



• Review three-bureau credit reports

• Analyze accounts for factual inconsistencies

• Review cases identified by our system

• Prepare dispute work through established workflows

• Review bureau investigation results

• Identify when additional evidence is needed

• Help determine appropriate follow-up actions

• Maintain accurate case records inside CPA

• Escalate questionable or unsupported cases for review

• Identify legitimate opportunities our system may have missed



We want someone who THINKS — not someone who simply clicks buttons.



If our system recommends an action that you believe is unsupported by the evidence, we expect you to STOP and flag it rather than blindly submit it.



Accuracy and judgment are more important than volume.



TO APPLY:



At the VERY BEGINNING of your application, write:



EVIDENCE FIRST



Then answer ALL 12 questions below.



1. How long have you worked specifically in U.S. credit repair, and what were your main responsibilities?



2. Which credit-repair platforms or CRMs have you used?



3. Which types of negative accounts or credit-report issues have you personally worked with?



4. A client's account appears on all three bureaus. Experian reports a 90-day late payment for a particular month, Equifax reports the account current for that same month, and TransUnion reports a 30-day late payment.



Walk us through what you would examine BEFORE deciding whether a dispute should be made.



5. A credit bureau responds to a dispute by saying an account was "verified." What would you review before deciding what should happen next?



6. Give an example of a situation where you would NOT dispute a negative account even though the client wants it removed. Explain why.



7. What is your understanding of a Method of Verification request?



8. What experience, if any, do you have with CFPB complaints or direct furnisher disputes?



9. Imagine the software you are using recommends disputing an account, but after reviewing the report you believe the evidence does not support the dispute. What would you do?



10. Tell us about one difficult credit-report case you personally worked on. What did you notice, what action did you take, and what happened afterward? Do not provide confidential client information.



11. What hours are you normally available to work, in Philippine Time?



12. What hourly rate are you requesting in USD?



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our operation.



Please answer the questions yourself and be prepared to discuss your answers during an interview.

REQUIREMENTS

WORK DETAILS

========================================



- 4 hours per day

HOW TO APPLY

title: Point of View (POV) driving video
description:
I am looking for a high-quality, Point of View (POV) driving video. The final product must feel completely immersive, as if the viewer is actually sitting in the driver's seat.

Reference Style: Please review the YouTube channel SEAN McLaren P for the exact pacing, camera angle, and audio focus I need.

1. Camera & Audio Setup

 Camera Mount: You must use a head mount or a helmet chin mount. Chest mounts sit too low and cut off the windshield, ruining the true driver's perspective.

 Camera Settings: Record in 1080p or higher resolution at 60fps. Use an Ultra-Wide or SuperView lens setting so the steering wheel, dashboard, and the road are all visible at once. In-camera stabilization (like HyperSmooth) must be turned on.

 Audio (Crucial): Audio makes or breaks a POV video. Please use a binaural microphone setup (in-ear mics) or a high-quality external stereo mic inside the cabin. Keep the windows rolled up for the majority of the drive to avoid wind distortion.

2. Video Structure (Shot List)

Please film the video in one continuous take or clear sequential clips following this structure:

 Exterior Walkaround (2-3 mins): Start outside. Walk around the entire car smoothly. Open the trunk, show the rear seats, and finally get into the driver's seat.

 Start-Up & Interior (2 mins): Once seated, look at the dashboard and start the engine. Let the exhaust sound play out. Slowly glance at the infotainment screen, center console, and test a few tactile buttons (indicators, windows, climate controls).

 The Drive (10-15 mins):

 Casual Drive: Drive smoothly in normal traffic.

 Acceleration: Find a safe, open stretch of road or a tunnel to accelerate (in Sport Mode if applicable) so the engine tone is clearly audible.

 Night Drive (Bonus): If the car features strong interior ambient lighting, recording at night is highly preferred.

3. Driving & Recording Rules

 Total Silence: There should be absolutely no talking and no radio/music. Let the car's mechanics do the talking—whether you're recording a modern VW Golf 7 or a classic like a Mercedes 190E, viewers are there to hear the engine and interior clicks.

 Smooth Head Movements: Move your head slowly and deliberately. When looking at the mirrors or center console, pause for a full second before looking back at the road. Rapid head movements will ruin the footage.

 Hand Position: Keep both hands visible on the steering wheel in a professional position whenever you aren't shifting gears or operating the screen.

4. Deliverables

 Deliver the raw, unedited 4K video files (or lightly color-graded if we agreed upon a specific LUT).

 Thumbnail Assets: Before or after the drive, please take a few crisp, eye-level photos of the car's exterior front angle and the interior dashboard. These are necessary to build bold, split-screen thumbnails.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



If you have never worked a graveyard shift before, think carefully before applying. We will ask you specifically how you plan to structure your sleep, and how you'll make the schedule work alongside your family or partner. "I'll figure it out" is not an answer that gets you hired. This shift is sustainable for people who plan for it and difficult for people who don't.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor Needed for YouTube Channel, 10 to 15 Minute Videos**



Hey there! I'm starting a brand new YouTube channel and looking for a video editor to join me on this journey. I've run channels before and worked with a lot of different editors over the years, and now I'm ready to build a real team again, starting with the right editor, then growing from there as things take off.



Videos are typically 10 to 15 minutes long, and I care deeply about the audio experience. Sound design and music are just as important to me as the visuals. I'm really interested in the audio side of editing specifically. The sound effects, the pacing, and that human emotional connection are absolutely key for this niche.



**IMPORTANT: NO AI GENERATED CONTENT. NO AI IMAGES. NO AI VIDEO. NO AI, PERIOD.** This channel is built on genuine, hands on, human editing only. I want it to feel personal and real, and that human touch matters more to me than anything else.



What you'll be doing:



Edit videos using a human voiceover that I'll provide. Source and gather your own supplemental clips and footage, in addition to clips I send you. Clean, polished editing with smooth pacing, no rough cuts or jarring transitions. Add on screen text where it helps, for emphasis or key points, used strategically, not overdone. Select and mix background music and sound effects that are free to use on YouTube with no copyright strikes. Create a personal, intimate feeling in the audio. This is a top priority for me. Match the tone and quality bar of these channels, which I'll share as reference: Beyond the Blue, Octo Lab, Beyond the Green, Fossil Videos, Mister Science, and Primordia Origins.



What I'm looking for in you:



A strong portfolio of similar long form YouTube edits. An excellent ear for music and sound design and pacing. Comfort sourcing b-roll and stock clips independently. Reliable communication, and openness to feedback and revisions. Ambition and a willingness to put in the work. title: Business Loan Sales Consultant / Closer — Warm Leads — AU Day Shift
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Have you sold business loans, mortgages, asset finance or insurance? Bring your closing experience to Ezy Pzy Finance and help Australian business owners access funding.

We also welcome proven sales professionals from other industries who can demonstrate consistent target achievement and experience closing business over the phone.

You’ll receive warm enquiries, product training, weekly coaching and the opportunity to earn commission on both new and repeat clients.





YOUR EARNING OPPORTUNITY



•During probation: AUD $500/week + commissions + bonuses (approx. ₱97,500/month fixed base). After 8 weeks probation: AUD $650/week including PhilCare allowance + commissions (approx. ₱126,750/month fixed pay).

• Our agents currently average AUD $5,200/month (₱234,000/month) in total earnings including commissions and monthly bonuses.

• Earn between AUD $100 - $800 (approximately ₱4,500–₱36,000) commission per deal..

• Repeat business stays with you: when a client you funded returns for more funding, you handle their next deal and earn commission again.

• Earn additional monthly performance bonuses based on KPI’s achieved.

After your two-month probation, benefits include the base salary increase, an HMO allowance, paid annual and sick leave, and access to higher bonus tiers.





WHO WE ARE



Ezy Pzy Finance is a fast growing Australian business finance company connecting business owners with a panel of non-bank lenders.

We’re growing our remote sales team and looking for consultants who combine strong closing skills with clear communication and disciplined follow-up.

Learn more: 





WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Call Australian business owners who have already expressed interest in funding.

• Understand their business, funding needs and timing.

• Qualify enquiries and guide clients through the application process.

• Explain available options clearly, handle objections and move deals towards settlement.

• Keep your pipeline organised and follow up consistently.

• Build relationships that generate repeat business.



Warm leads are provided. There is no cold prospecting or list building, but the role involves regular outbound calls and persistent follow-up.





WHO SHOULD APPLY



You have at least two years of phone-based sales experience and have personally been responsible for closing sales and achieving targets.



We particularly welcome sales experience in:



• Business lending or merchant cash advance campaigns.

• Australian or US mortgage and asset finance.

• Insurance, debt solutions or other financial products.



Successful closers from other industries are also encouraged to apply. Show us what you sold, your targets, your results and your role in winning the business.



You should be able to:



• Build trust and communicate confidently in spoken English.

• Run a discovery conversation and ask useful follow-up questions.

• Explain products clearly and handle objections professionally.

• Own your pipeline, maintain accurate records and follow through.

• Learn new products and apply coaching.



Finance processing, customer service or appointment-setting experience is useful, but you must also demonstrate personal closing experience.





TRAINING AND SUPPORT



Your first four weeks include structured product and sales training, with an initial focus on smaller loan facilities up to approximately A$30,000.

You’ll progress to larger deals as you meet quality and settlement milestones, supported by weekly one-to-one sales coaching.





SCHEDULE AND SETUP



• Monday–Friday, 6:30am–4:30pm Philippine time.

• One-hour lunch break; 45 working hours/week.

• Fully remote, with evenings free.

• Reliable computer, internet connection and backup internet/power arrangements required.





HOW TO APPLY



Incomplete applications will not be considered. Complete applications get a response within 48 hours.

Provide ALL 5 of the following:

A short video (3–5 minutes, Loom / Google Drive / unlisted YouTube link) in two parts:



Part 1 — introduce yourself, your sales experience, and the results/KPIs you achieved (numbers, not adjectives).



Part 2 — a 2-minute mock opening of a discovery call: pretend you’ve just dialled an Australian business owner from Ezy Pzy Finance — do your opening, build rapport, and start qualifying them for funding.



- Link to your resume.

- Screenshots of your DISC assessment and IQ test results (tests available at 
/testcontent).

- Screenshot of your internet speed test, provider, and PC/laptop specs.

- Your backup internet and power solutions.

- Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a Zoom interview, including a live discovery-call role-play.





If you’re a top performing sales professional and have the self drive to earn big commissions and grow in a company that is focused on long term success, then submit your application and we’ll see if we’re a good fit to work together.

Strong spoken and written English

Confidence handling customer calls

Strong organization and multitasking skills

Excellent attention to detail

Strong follow-through

Ability to work independently

Reliable internet and professional remote work setup



2+ years of pest control experience is strongly preferred.



Pest Control Software



Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:



FieldRoutes / PestRoutes

PestPac

GorillaDesk

ServiceTitan

Housecall Pro

Jobber

Service Fusion

Other pest control or field-service CRM systems



You do not need experience with every platform listed.



FieldRoutes or PestPac experience is highly preferred, but candidates with strong pest control experience using another system are encouraged to apply.



Who We're Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you:



Already understand how a pest control office operates

Know how recurring pest-control services are scheduled

Are comfortable talking with homeowners

Can confidently book appointments

Can coordinate technicians and changing schedules

Understand the importance of accurate service notes

Stay calm when customers are frustrated

Follow up until issues are resolved

Can handle several customers and appointments at once

Communicate proactively with technicians

Take ownership instead of waiting to be reminded

Are dependable and comfortable being accountable for results



We are not looking for someone who simply answers calls.



We want someone who can:

Please Do Not Apply If

You have never worked in the pest control industry

Your experience is limited to generic customer service with no pest-control exposure

You are uncomfortable speaking with customers by phone

You are uncomfortable managing schedules or coordinating technicians

You need constant supervision

You have difficulty communicating clearly in English

PEST CONTROL CSR – [NUMBER] YEARS

PEST CONTROL CSR – 3 YEARS

title: Software Developer, Product & Business Analyst
description:
We are looking for an exceptionally versatile, technically minded person to join our team.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant role, and it is not purely a developer role. We are looking for someone who can operate across product, engineering, client operations, data analysis, QA, and general technical problem-solving.



The ideal candidate has a strong technical background and knows how to code, but also has excellent business judgment, analytical ability, communication skills, and the flexibility to work on a very wide variety of projects.



You should be the type of person who enjoys being given a problem, figuring out how everything works, and finding the best way to solve it, even when there is no step-by-step process already written for you.



What your job will involve:



1. Building software and internal tools. You will sometimes develop new functionality yourself, including working with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Codex.



2. Product development and brainstorming. Help us think through new product functionality, identify edge cases, determine how features should work, and translate business needs into technical solutions.



3. Client technical setup. Configure new clients across our platforms, understand their websites and technology stacks, analyze their products and businesses, and make sure everything is implemented correctly.



4. Technical troubleshooting. Investigate issues, determine why something is not working, and either fix the problem yourself or clearly communicate the issue to our engineering team.



5. QA and bug testing. Thoroughly test new functionality, identify bugs and edge cases, reproduce issues, and help make sure our products work correctly before and after launch.



6. APIs, integrations, and technical configuration. Work with APIs, webhooks, tracking scripts, integrations, platform settings, data feeds, and similar technical systems.



7. Website and platform work. Handle tasks involving platforms such as Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, analytics tools, and other SaaS products.



8. Data and business analysis. Analyze information, spreadsheets, customer data, and product performance to help us answer questions and make better decisions.



9. Research and problem-solving. Quickly learn unfamiliar technologies, investigate technical questions, and independently determine how to accomplish things we have never done before.



10. General technical operations. Help wherever needed. Some projects will be sophisticated and highly technical. Others may be relatively simple administrative or operational tasks that simply need to get done correctly.



What we are looking for:



-Meaningful programming and development experience. You do not need to be a senior software engineer, but you should be comfortable writing, reading, and understanding code.



-Strong understanding of how web applications and websites work.



-Comfortable learning and working with APIs, integrations, JSON, webhooks, tracking scripts, and unfamiliar technical systems.



-Experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar tools is a major plus.



-Comfortable troubleshooting technical problems independently.



-Experience with Git and GitHub is strongly preferred.



-A Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Analytics, or related technical background is preferred, but demonstrated ability matters more than a specific degree.



-Strong business judgment. You should understand that the goal is not simply to make something technically work, but to understand why we are building it and what business outcome we are trying to achieve.



-Excellent critical thinking and analytical skills.



-Ability to take a complicated or ambiguous problem and break it into smaller pieces.



-Comfortable working with data and spreadsheets.



-Experience with eCommerce, particularly Shopify, is a major plus.



-Familiarity with metrics such as AOV, ROAS, CTR, CVR, and LTV, as well as eCommerce funnels such as Product View, Add to Cart, Checkout, and Purchase, is helpful.



-Fully fluent spoken and written English is required.



-Able to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical people.



-Strong written communication and documentation skills.



-Comfortable communicating directly with clients when necessary.



-The type of person who will succeed in this role:



-You are extremely resourceful. When you encounter something you do not know, your first instinct is to research it, experiment, and figure it out.



-You are a strong problem solver. You enjoy investigating why something is happening rather than simply escalating every problem to someone else.



-You are highly detail-oriented. Small technical details matter, and you naturally notice when something looks wrong.



-You are comfortable with ambiguity. Many projects will begin with an objective rather than detailed instructions.



-You are extremely versatile. You might spend part of the day debugging software, part configuring a client account, part testing a new product feature, and part analyzing a spreadsheet.



-You have no ego about the work. You are equally willing to work on an important new product feature or complete a straightforward administrative task that needs to get done.



-You are proactive. We value people who identify problems and opportunities without waiting to be told exactly what to do.



-You are reliable and organized. You can manage multiple projects, communicate status clearly, and follow through.



-You are curious and genuinely enjoy learning new tools, technologies, and systems.



Requirements:



-Excellent spoken and written English



-Strong and reliable internet connection



-Reliable modern computer



-Significant overlap with U.S. Eastern Time working hours



-Prior professional experience in a technical role



-Ability to demonstrate actual programming ability



Nice to have:



-Shopify experience



-SaaS experience



-eCommerce experience



-Startup experience



-Product management or product development experience



-Business intelligence or analytics experience



-Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills



-Experience working directly with U.S.-based companies or clients



Most important:



-We care much more about how you think and what you can do than the exact titles you have held.



-The ideal person for this position might have previously worked as a developer, technical analyst, technical product specialist, solutions engineer, product owner, business systems analyst, business analyst, or in another hybrid technical and business role.



-If you are someone who can code, analyze, troubleshoot, communicate, understand the business objective, and figure things out independently, we want to hear from you.

title: Product Listing Specialist · Shopify x Google (3 Dropshipping Stores)
description:
Who we are



We run three e-commerce stores that reach customers through Google Ads and Google Shopping. That means how our products show up on Shopify and in the Google feed makes a real difference to how the stores perform.



We're looking for someone to help us build and maintain great product listings across all three stores.



The role



You'll be responsible for listing 5 products per day per store, so 15 products in total per day. Concretely:



Building product pages on Shopify (title, description, images, variants, pricing, inventory, tags)

Writing product titles and descriptions that read naturally and rank on the right keywords

Categorising products correctly using the Google Product Taxonomy

Managing the product feed through Google Merchant Center: GTIN, MPN, brand, condition, and all required fields

Making sure listings feel unique and on-brand, not like a standard dropship import

Alt-text and image SEO on product images

Fixing disapproved products in Merchant Center



We have full SOPs and prompts ready for each store, so you don't have to figure out the format yourself. You follow the SOP, and where the SOP leaves room you use your own judgement.



Compensation



$0.30 per listed product. A product only counts when it is fully completed to SOP standard and ready to go active (not a draft with half the fields filled in).



At 15 products per day across the working days of the month, this comes to a stable monthly amount. Paid once per month via IBAN.



What we're looking for



Some experience with Shopify product listings, ideally in a dropshipping or e-commerce setting

Familiarity with Google Merchant Center and the Google Product Taxonomy

You can write product titles and descriptions that sound natural

You work independently and take ownership of your work

Comfortable in Shopify backend, Google Merchant Center, and basic SEO tools

Available at least 4 hours per day, consistently

Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT or similar) as part of the workflow, while making sure the output still reads human



If you have some experience but not all of the above, still feel free to reach out. What matters most is that you're eager to do this well and can pick things up quickly.



Why this role is worth your time



Steady work, clear volume expectations, clear pay per product. No guessing, no half work, no chasing invoices.



There's a path to grow into a bigger role over time. As we scale, the person in this seat has the opportunity to take on more responsibility and grow into a Listing & Catalogue Manager role.



You'll work directly with the owner, no layer of middle management in between.



How to apply



Reply to this listing with:



A short message about your background and any Shopify or Google listing experience you have

A 1-2 minute Loom video in English introducing yourself and telling us why you'd be a good fit

If you have any product page you've built that you're proud of, feel free to share a link



The first week is a paid trial. You'll work on real products across one of the stores under supervision, and we'll see how it goes on both sides.

title: Ads Manager - Paid Media Strategist & Creative Producer
description:
Who We Are



We're The Creative Brand Architects. We specialize in helping ecommerce brands and local brick-and-mortar companies grow through a strategic digital marketing presence.



We're not interested in marketing that looks pretty and does nothing. We install marketing systems that convert. As previous owners of a $10M ecommerce brand, we've sat on the other side of the table. We know what it costs a founder when an agency hides behind vanity metrics. That's why it's critically important to us that we help other founders scale with honesty, integrity, and real measurable growth.



We've just signed an eleven-location boutique Pilates studio, and we're looking for an **Ads Manager** to own their paid media end-to-end — with room to manage more client accounts as we scale.



---



Who We're Looking For



We're not looking for someone who just pushes buttons in Ads Manager.



This is not an entry-level role. You will be responsible for $15,000–$18,000 per month in client ad spend from day one. If you have not personally managed budgets at that level, this role is not for you.



We're looking for an owner — someone who can look at a client's business, decide what the paid strategy should be, build the creative that carries it, run the account day to day, and then tell us honestly what the numbers mean.



If you're someone who is:



- 📈 Genuinely analytical — you get satisfaction from finding out why a campaign is working, not just that it is.

- 🎬 Creative and hands-on — you can concept an angle and then actually build the ad, not just brief someone else to do it.

- 🔍 Obsessive about tracking — you don't trust a number until you've checked how it's being measured.

- 🧪 Disciplined about testing — you change one thing at a time and you write down what happened.

- 💰 Careful with other people's money — five figures a month in spend doesn't rattle you, and you treat it like it's coming out of your own account.

- 🗣️ Straight with people — you'd rather flag a problem on Tuesday than explain it in the monthly report.

- 🚀 Ambitious — you want to become the person our clients ask for by name.



...then we should talk.



---



Position Details



- Employment Type: Part-Time Contractor (with a clear path to more accounts)

- Work Schedule: Flexible, with set weekly deadlines and daily account check-ins

- Expected Workload: Approximately 14 hours per week to start

- Starting Account: 🧘 An eleven-location boutique Pilates studio — local lead generation across all 11 locations, with location-level campaign structure, geo-targeting, and per-location reporting

- Platforms: Meta Ads and Google Ads

- Ad Spend Under Management: $15,000–$18,000 per month. This is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.

- Scope: Ad strategy, ad creative production, ad account management, and reporting. Landing pages, websites, and funnels are handled by other experts on our team — you focus entirely on the ads.

- Tools Required to Use: Notion, Slack, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, GA4

- Client Engagement: You'll work directly with our Founder. Client communication is handled by a separate role on our team — you own the account performance and the reporting that supports it.

- Growth Path: As we onboard additional brands, this role expands in scope, hours, and pay.



---



Responsibilities



- 🎯 Build the full paid media strategy for each account — offer, audience, funnel structure, channel mix, and budget allocation.

- 🏗️ Structure, build, and launch Meta and Google campaigns, including geo-targeted campaigns across all 11 studio locations.

- 💰 Manage $15,000–$18,000 per month in ad spend with precise pacing and zero overspends.

- 📅 Manage the account daily: monitor pacing, performance, and delivery, and make the calls that protect performance.

- 💡 Develop creative angles, hooks, and offers based on customer research and performance data.

- ✂️ Produce the ad creative yourself — short-form video edits, UGC-style ads, statics, and carousels.

- ✍️ Write ad copy that carries the offer clearly and in the client's voice.

- 🧪 Run structured creative tests with a stated hypothesis and document every result in Notion.

- 🔗 Set up and maintain tracking: pixels, Conversions API, conversion events, UTMs, and offline conversion imports from the client's booking platform.

- 📊 Deliver a weekly performance snapshot and a monthly deep-dive that explain the numbers in plain language.

- 🔎 Monitor competitors and the boutique fitness category for offers, angles, and creative worth borrowing.

- 🤝 Collaborate with our strategy, content, and web teams so paid media reinforces everything else the client is doing.

- 🤖 Use AI tools to speed up research, creative iteration, and reporting — without letting quality slip.



---



What Makes This Role Exciting



- 🧘 A real account with real scale. Eleven locations and $15K–$18K a month in spend, in a category where good paid media makes an immediate, visible difference to a business.

- 🎯 You own it. Strategy, creative, and execution all sit with you. You won't be handed a media plan and told to push buttons.

- 🎬 Ads only, no distractions. You're not getting pulled into websites, funnels, or organic content. Your job is the ads and the numbers they produce.

- 📈 You'll build a specialism. Boutique fitness — Pilates, yoga, and studio memberships — is a category with real depth. Become the person who knows it better than anyone.

- 🚀 Growth is built in. We're actively scaling. Perform here and you take on more accounts and more pay.

- 🤝 You'll work directly with the decision-makers.** Your ideas will actually get used.



---



What We Expect From You



- Proven experience personally managing $15,000+ per month in ad spend. You'll be asked for specifics.

- Proven hands-on experience managing Meta and Google ad accounts, with results you can talk through in detail.

- Direct experience with lead generation — ideally local or multi-location, ideally in fitness, wellness, or a service business.

- Ability to produce your own ad creative to a professional standard (video editing and static design).

- Working knowledge of conversion tracking: pixel, Conversions API, GA4, UTMs, and connecting third-party booking or ecommerce platforms.

- Strong analytical judgment — you can tell the difference between a real result and noise.

- Clear, proactive communication and a genuine ownership mindset.

- Comfort with being measured against specific numbers, and honest when those numbers are bad.



---



How We Will Help You Succeed



- Systems That Set You Up for Success — SOPs, Notion workflows, and clear processes. You won't be building the infrastructure from scratch.

- Strategic Partnership — Direct access to our brand and strategy leads, so paid media isn't happening in a vacuum.

- A Team Behind the Ads — Websites, landing pages, and funnels are handled by our team. You're not fixing someone else's page before you can run traffic to it.

- Creative Support — Access to client brand assets, footage, and our content team for raw material.

- Feedback That Fuels Growth — Regular, direct feedback designed to sharpen your work.

- Flexibility with Accountability — Work remotely and manage your own schedule. We care about the numbers and the deadlines, not about watching you work.

- Real Growth Opportunities — More accounts, more responsibility, and higher pay as we scale.



---



Employment Type



This is a part-time contractor role with the opportunity to grow into a larger, better-paid engagement as we add accounts. We are hiring an individual, not an agency.



---



Application Process



Please include the word "Reformer" after your first and last name when you apply.



In your application, include:



1. The largest monthly ad spend you have personally managed — your own accounts, not your agency's combined total.

2. Two accounts you've personally managed — the client type, the monthly spend, the objective, and the result. Be specific with numbers.

3. Three ad creatives you made yourself — with a line on the thinking behind each.

4. A short Loom (3–5 minutes) walking us through one campaign you ran: what you built, what you tested, what happened, and what you'd do differently.



Applications without the keyword, the spend figures, or the Loom will not be reviewed.



$10–$15 USD per hour, based on experience and proven results.

- At the starting scope of approximately 14 hours per week, that works out to roughly $600–$910 USD per month

- Compensation increases as you take on additional accounts.



---



Apply Here

title: Real Estate Research VA — Distressed Property Lists (PropStream) | Part-Time to Full-Time
description:
We are a licensed real estate investor and contractor in Pinellas County, Florida (Tampa Bay). We buy distressed single-family homes as-is, renovate them, and either flip or list them. We need a reliable research VA who already knows U.S. property data — not a general assistant we have to train from zero.

This is NOT a cold-calling closer role, and you will NOT negotiate offers. You build lists, skip-trace, keep the CRM clean, and hand us sellers we can talk to.

What you will do

• Pull weekly owner lists in PropStream (or similar) using our buy-box filters: Pinellas County plus nearby zip codes we name, absentee owners, high equity, pre-foreclosure, tax delinquent, probate, vacant, and code-violation flags.

• Skip-trace owners and load name, phones,
s, mailing address, property facts, and motivation tags into our CRM.

• Prepare direct-mail lists (CSV) that match our filters. Flag bounce-backs and bad phones.

• Support driving-for-dollars: look up addresses we send from the field, confirm owner, occupancy, and equity, and add them to the list the same day.

• Pull comps and basic property facts so we can underwrite faster. You do not set offer price.

• Send a short end-of-day report: lists pulled, records skip-traced, CRM records added, problems.

Requirements (must have)

• Prior work for a U.S. real estate investor, wholesaler, or flipper — say which markets and which tools.

• Hands-on PropStream  is a plus.

• Clean written English. We will judge this from your application, not a resume template.

• Reliable computer, headset, and weekday overlap with U.S. Eastern Time (at least 4 hours).

• Able to follow a written buy box without improvising filters.

Nice to have

• Skip-tracing tools, Google Sheets / Excel, GoHighLevel or similar CRM, county assessor / Pinellas property appraiser comfort.

Pay

Part-time start: $6–$8/hour for proven PropStream experience. Full-time: $1,000–$1,600/month depending on speed and accuracy. Paid weekly or twice monthly as a contractor. Software logins we provide. We do not pay for a learning period if you claimed experience you do not have.

How to apply (this is the filter)

Do not send a generic VA resume. In one page tell us:

1. 1) Which U.S. investor you worked for and what lists you pulled.

2. 2) Which tools you used last (name the product).

3. 3) How many records you can skip-trace cleanly in a 4-hour block.

4. 4) Your rate and hours available in Eastern Time.

5) Paid test (if we shortlist you): pull 25 Pinellas absentee + high-equity owners that match a written filter. We will pay a small test fee.

-

title: AI Film Analysis and Training Specialist
description:
ScreenGen is hiring an AI Film Analysis and Training Specialist to help build an AI system that writes compelling scenes, plans cinematic coverage, and adapts novels into screenplays.



Full-time | Remote - Philippines | USD $300-$500 per month, depending on experience.



We are looking for a resourceful, detail-oriented person who combines strong film and storytelling judgment with practical AI experience and technical confidence. You will follow documented operating handbooks, use coding agents for technical tasks, and independently evaluate film analysis, training examples, generated scenes, shot plans, and complete adaptations.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Organize films, scripts and manuscripts; verify matching source materials and preserve source provenance.

- Run a three-pass film analysis workflow: whole-film overview, scene-by-scene deconstruction, and final reconciliation.

- Check scene boundaries, dialogue, character identities, action, coverage, continuity and dramatic function against the actual film.

- Select strong teaching examples and review AI-generated writing assignments and directing briefs against their paired scenes and shot plans.

- Maintain consistent labels and versioned datasets. Keep related books, editions, screenplay drafts and derived examples together in either training or evaluation, and prevent target-answer leakage.

- Use coding agents to set up tools, run documented workflows, inspect logs, test application changes and troubleshoot routine problems.

- Run approved fine-tuning procedures, track datasets and checkpoints, and compare trained models with their baselines before recommending release.

- Evaluate new storyline outputs and adaptations of held-out books; document strengths, failures, revision effort and needed improvements.

- Review links between novels and screenplays, including condensation, restructuring, merged characters, omissions and inventions.

- Review complete screenplay outputs and proposed repairs. Distinguish reusable, conditional lessons from story-specific corrections, and approve only within the authority assigned by the owner.

- Operate the application that stores preferences, evidence, approved lessons and feedback. Track lesson updates through example preparation, training, evaluation and deployment, and report missing or failed updates.



REQUIRED SKILLS



- Experience in screenwriting, script development, directing, editing, film analysis or a closely related discipline.

- Strong scene-level judgment: explain how a scene develops character, changes the dramatic situation, manages information and serves a larger sequence.

- Understanding of shot sizes, camera movement, blocking, staging, eyelines, screen direction, continuity, pacing and coverage.

- Book-to-screenplay adaptation judgment, including character arcs, compression, restructuring, visual storytelling and purposeful narration.

- Practical AI-tool experience and the ability to identify unsupported outputs.

- Confidence with files, command-line instructions, software setup, logs and structured data. Advanced programming is not required.

- Careful data handling, clear written communication and independent execution of detailed processes.

- Working understanding of input/target pairs, held-out evaluation material, data leakage, and synthetic versus human-reviewed examples.

- Ability to assess whether a correction solves a problem and whether a lesson generalizes beyond one story.



USEFUL ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE



English script coverage, story editing, assistant editing, continuity work, film annotation, dataset curation or AI output evaluation; coding agents such as Claude Code or GPT-6 Astra; Python, Git, Linux/Ubuntu, Docker, FFmpeg, JSON/JSONL, APIs or database-backed applications; supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3-32B or comparable open-weight models; PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, bitsandbytes, Axolotl or LoRA/QLoRA; multi-GPU operations, diagnostics and checkpoint recovery; applications with replaceable model connections, approval queues, scheduled retraining and release rollback.



The planned workstation uses two RTX A4500 20 GB GPUs with NVLink. Experience with comparable systems is useful.



Experience with every tool is not required. Strong film and adaptation judgment, disciplined verification, and the ability to learn AI-assisted technical workflows are essential. You should be able to troubleshoot a documented procedure and recognize when specialist support is needed.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include your CV.

description:
Job Title: After Effects Editor / Motion Designer for Documentary YouTube Channel
