title: Junior Video Editor - Technical Video and Real Film Work
description:
*** Please read the entire post before applying. Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you want editing work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, first responder, and other technical clients. You will help turn complex subjects into something clear and usable, whether that means explaining how satellites stay in orbit, helping engineers communicate their work, or building training content people can actually follow. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Projects range from short explainers to long-form training content. Aerospace, defense, and first responder are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.



Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress.



The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project.



Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes.



Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency.



Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals.



Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product.



Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software: Solid working proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Preferred): Experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. If you have not handled RED RAW, you must be a fast learner who can manage complex, high-resolution media.



Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume.



Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar)

- Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $8.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,280 USD per month (about 39,000 to 78,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $640 USD per month (about 20,000 to 39,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Dedicated Video Editor - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration.



***On your portfolio: Send me real work, not volume. Do not send a reel, a montage, or a folder with fifty UGC ads, TikToks, and social cuts in it. A montage tells me nothing about whether you can structure a piece. I want links to complete finished videos, with the runtime stated, and a one-line note on what you were responsible for on each.



If you do not have long-form finished work, say so directly in your application. That is a fair answer and it will not get you thrown out. Padding the link with short-form to make the portfolio look full will.***



- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- Want to stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest.

title: Website Developer Wanted: Author Site + Book Lore Wiki for Oct 31 Launch

We're building the official website for author J. Martin Lutece, launching alongside his upcoming book Summons of the Eight Divinity on October 31, 2026.



We're looking for a developer who can build a clean, professional author/book website — and ideally bring in some wiki-style functionality for exploring the book's world, characters, and lore, similar in spirit to how game companion wikis are structured (for reference, see how Bandai Namco laid out the Elden Ring Nightreign wiki:

Clean, modern design that feels professional and matches the tone of a character-driven science fiction series

Mobile-responsive — most traffic will likely come from social media links

Integration with our social accounts and presale/purchase links

A portfolio of relevant past work (especially any wiki-style or content-organized sites)

Your recommended platform/approach and why

Whether you're open to ongoing maintenance work after launch



Note: This is for a real book launch with a fixed, non-negotiable deadline — please only apply if you're confident you can deliver by October 15, 2026.

This is a unique role for someone who enjoys solving problems, building better systems, and finding smarter ways to operate IT and security environments.



This position will provide early-morning coverage for our clients and internal operations, with light responsibility for responding to inbound support requests by phone and
. However, this is not primarily a help desk position.

title: Legal Intake & Sales Specialist – Immigration Law Firm
description:

You will often be the first human interaction a prospective client has with our firm. We are looking for someone who can make prospective clients feel comfortable, listen carefully, gather information efficiently, explain our consultation process clearly, consistently follow up, and confidently guide qualified prospective clients toward taking the next step.



This is both a client-service and sales position. You should be comfortable speaking with people on the phone, discussing consultation fees, handling objections, following up with leads, and asking prospective clients to book a consultation.

Persistent with follow-up without being aggressive or pushy

Able to follow scripts without sounding robotic

Excellent organization and CRM habits

Comfortable learning new software and using AI tools

Reliable internet connection and a quiet professional environment for calls

Law-firm experience is helpful but not required

Immigration experience is a plus but not required



Please apply only if the $6–$7/hour compensation range works for you.



HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Please submit all of the following:



1. Résumé



2. Voice Recording

Send a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be good at speaking with prospective immigration clients. Please do not simply read from a prepared script.

Briefly describe your previous experience with sales, intake, appointment setting, customer service, or phone-based work.

A prospective client calls and says:



“Hi, I'm calling different immigration attorneys to find out how much they charge for a marriage green card. How much does your firm charge?”



Write exactly what you would say next.



5. Free Consultation Test



A prospective client says:



“I don't want to pay $200 for a consultation. I only have one quick question. Can I just ask the attorney?”



Write exactly what you would say.

You explain the consultation process and the caller responds:



“Okay, let me think about it and I'll call you back.”



Write exactly what you would say next.



7. Follow-Up Test



A prospective client spoke with you yesterday and seemed very interested but did not book a consultation.



Write the text message you would send the prospective client the next day.

A caller asks:



“I overstayed my visa, but I'm married to a U.S. citizen. Can I still get a green card?”



Write what you would do or say.

Start the first line of your application with the exact words:



CLIENT FIRST

Asset Finance Support

Remote / Work from Home |AEST Hours | Supporting Australian Asset Finance Brokers



Who We're Looking For

We're building a dedicated team of asset finance support professionals to work directly with Australian asset finance brokers. If you have hands-on experience processing equipment, vehicle, or commercial asset finance applications and understand the end-to-end broker workflow, we want to hear from you.



To Apply, please submit this form:  



What You'll Be Doing Every Day



Managing asset finance files end-to-end — from initial client enquiry through to settlement and post-settlement

Data entry and file management in broker CRM platforms (Mercury, Salesforce, or equivalent)

Preparing and submitting finance applications to lenders via broker portals

Ordering and tracking asset valuations and credit assessments

Requesting and tracking pricing and rate concessions from lenders

Running asset finance calculators — balloon payments, residual values, comparison rates, repayment schedules

Preparing compliance documents, credit diary notes, settlement letters, and payout figures

Ordering and interpreting commercial credit reports (e.g. Equifax, CreditorWatch, Veda)

Coordinating with lenders, vendors, dealers, and clients throughout the approval and settlement process

Managing discharge and payout requests, PPSR checks, and ASIC searches

Preparing funds-to-complete confirmations and settlement instructions

Post-settlement tasks — invoice reconciliation, asset registration follow-up, client retention





You Must Have

2–3 years of experience in Australian asset finance — broker-side, not lender operations

Asset finance product knowledge — equipment finance, chattel mortgage, novated lease, hire purchase, commercial hire purchase, finance lease, operating lease

 Lender portal experience — submitting and tracking applications with major AU asset finance lenders (e.g. Westpac, NAB, ANZ, Macquarie, Pepper Money, Angle Finance, Grow Finance, Shift, ScotPac, Liberty, Fifo Capital)

Income assessment — PAYG, self-employed, company, and trust financials for asset finance purposes

CRM proficiency — Mercury, Salesforce, or comparable broker CRM

Understanding of GST, ABN, and tax implications relevant to asset finance structures

AEST business hours — full-time, Monday to Friday

Excellent written and spoken English — direct communication with brokers, clients, and lenders



Minimum Requirements



Strong understanding of chattel mortgage and finance lease structures

Comfortable handling multiple files simultaneously with strict attention to detail and deadlines

Familiar with PPSR (Personal Property Securities Register) searches and registrations

Understanding of responsible lending obligations and privacy requirements under Australian law

Proficient in Microsoft Office — Word, Excel, Outlook

Fast internet connection and professional home office setup





Nice to Have



Experience with novated leasing or fleet finance

Exposure to construction equipment, yellow goods, or specialised asset classes

Familiarity with commercial property-backed asset finance

Experience using ApplyOnline, Loanapp, or Simpology for commercial submissions

Cert IV in Finance & Mortgage Broking or equivalent





Education

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value hands-on Australian asset finance experience above qualifications. Candidates without a degree but with 2+ years of direct broker support experience are strongly encouraged to apply.



What We Offer



Competitive base salary based on experience

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months





About the Role

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.

title: Construction Video Editor
description:
Video Editor — Win the Role With a Paid Test Edit



Build Media Co.  |  Full-time, Remote (Philippines-based)  |  Starting pay: $750/month, with room to grow



The Short Version



We shoot real construction and design projects — real job sites, real homeowners, real craftsmanship. No stock footage, no AI b-roll pretending to be real. Our job is to make that footage look as good as the work itself deserves. Yours would be to cut it.



We're not doing a normal hiring process. Send us your portfolio — the top 6 get invited to a paid test edit, the top 3 test edits move on to a final interview, and the interview d
 who gets the job. No interviews-to-nowhere, no “we'll keep your resume on file.” You show us what you can do, we pay you for doing it, and the strongest editor earns the seat.



We've grown from 2 to 8 team members in under two years — and every single one of us is Filipino. Build Media Co. isn't a US company that outsources its editing overseas. It's a media company built, run, and grown entirely by Filipino talent, and we're proud of that. If you join us, you're not joining someone's overflow team — you're joining the team.



What You'd Actually Be Doing



You'd be editing vertical reels and social content for real contractors and designers — construction walkthroughs, before-and-afters, homeowner testimonials, job site b-roll. This is fast-paced, high-volume work: you'd own 16–20 short-form reels a month, roughly 30 seconds each. You'll be working alongside our existing editing team, with an experienced main editor to learn the pipeline from.



If you're good, there's a real path here. Our current main editor started at this same rate and has already grown well beyond it in about a year. We built this company from a small team and we grow the people already in it.



How the Process Works



This is a three-stage process, and we're upfront about every step:

1. Portfolio review. Everyone applies with a portfolio or reel. We review every submission.

2. Top 6 → Paid test edit. The 6 strongest portfolios get invited to a paid test edit. We send you raw footage from a real, active client project, and you have 3 days to cut it into the most engaging, creative, and technically clean edit you can make — vertical, social-ready. You're paid for the test edit regardless of outcome. Feedback runs through Dropbox Replay — timestamped, frame-accurate comments on the actual cut, no vague notes or endless back-and-forth. We do one revision round to gauge how well you incorporate edits and feedback.

3. Top 3 → Final interview. The 3 strongest test edits move on to a final interview. That interview — not the edit alone — determines who gets the job.



We're not looking for the fastest cut. We're looking for judgment — what you keep, what you cut, how you pace a story, and whether the final thing actually makes someone stop scrolling.



What We're Looking For

• Strong narrative instinct — you know how to find the story in raw footage, not just trim it

• Comfortable in Premiere Pro (our main NLE)

• An eye for pacing, sound design, and captions that make vertical video actually watchable

• Someone who takes feedback well and moves fast — we produce a high volume of content every month

• Bonus: experience with construction, real estate, home improvement, or lifestyle content

• Major bonus: you've worked or currently work in construction, architecture, civil engineering, interior design, or a related field. If you understand how a project actually comes together, it shows in how you cut it.



Before You Apply



We get a lot of applications, so make yours count. To apply send the following to 
 Title: Build Media Co Video Editor Application

• Attach your cv.

• Attach a link to your portfolio or reel — no exceptions. If you don't have client work yet, show us your best personal project.

• Answer this in your application: “What's one edit you're proud of, and what would you change about it if you had another day?” We're looking for editors who are honest about their own work, not editors who think everything they've made is perfect.

• Tell us what you like to do in your free time.

• Tell us your availability for a paid test edit within the next week, in case you're one of the top 6.



Applications without a portfolio or without an answer to the question above won't be considered.



Prizes

Every one of the top 6 gets paid for the test edit — advancing or not.



Outcome            Payout         What It Means

Top 3 test edits    $45–$75 Advance to a final interview, which d
 who's hired

4th–6th test edits    $35 each Paid for a strong effort, kept on file for future openings



The final interview — not the edit alone — determines who joins the team. If you're good, you get paid for proving it every step of the way.



The Details

title: SOCIAL MEDIA & E-COMMERCE VIRTUAL ASSISTANT
description:
SOCIAL MEDIA & E-COMMERCE VIRTUAL ASSISTANT

Men's Health Brand | Part Time to Full Time | Remote | Long-term



IMPORTANT

This is a hands-on management and coordination role. We are looking for one capable person to run our day-to-day social media, Meta advertising, and Shopify operations — and keep it all working together. If you only do one of these things, this role is probably not for you. If you can do all of them and enjoy owning the whole picture, keep reading.

This is not a role for the faint-hearted. We are a winning culture. We work hard, we back each other, and we expect everyone on the team to pull their weight and take pride in the result.



ABOUT DAYFUEL

Dayfuel is an Australian men's health brand helping everyday men feel better every day. We're not a bodybuilding brand. We're not a biohacking brand.

Most Australian men know they should be looking after themselves. The problem is life gets busy. That's where Dayfuel comes in. Our products are designed to make good nutrition easier, not more complicated.

Our voice is simple, practical, relatable, and occasionally a little dry. We speak like real Australians and avoid fitness clichés, miracle claims and health guru nonsense.



THE TEAM

You won't be doing this alone. Dayfuel already has a Creative Director, a Content Creator and a Video Creator. Your job is to be the engine room — taking what the creative team produces and making sure it gets published, promoted and converted, so all our efforts and messaging are rewarded.

You'll work directly with the founder and be a genuine part of the team, not an outsourced afterthought.



THE ROLE

You will be the person who keeps Dayfuel's daily marketing engine running. That includes:

Social Media Management



Scheduling and publishing posts, Reels and Stories on Instagram and

Managing our content calendar and coordinating with the creative team

Replying to DMs and comments in brand voice, and escalating anything important to the founder

Outreach DMs and engagement on relevant pages, groups and communities and reporting your activity every week. 



Meta Advertising



Managing campaigns in Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager

Monitoring ad performance, budgets and catalogue health

Weekly reporting on what's working and what's not — in plain English, not jargon



Coordination



Bringing all of the above together so content, ads and the website tell one consistent story

Making sure nothing the creative team produces sits idle and everything gets used, everything works

Then reporting this every Monday, where we are winning and where we are not and what we need to do to win. 





WHAT WE CARE ABOUT



Proven years of experience running Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager (not just boosting posts)

Excellent written English, you will be speaking as the brand

Organised, reliable and proactive. You see problems before we do

A winner's mindset  you take ownership, you follow through, and you don't go missing

Experience with health, wellness or e-commerce brands is a strong plus



We care more about what you've actually done than your resume. Show us accounts you've managed, ads you've run, and results you've achieved.



HOURS & RATE

Part-time to start (approximately 20 hours per week) with a clear path to full-time as the brand grows. USD $6–$9 per hour depending on experience, reviewed as you prove yourself.

We're a small, easy-going team and we genuinely value good people. If you take pride in your work, want to win, and want to be part of something being built from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

Together we achieve more at Dayfuel.



TO APPLY

Start your application with the phrase "I run the show!" so we know you've read this ad properly. Then tell us:



Two brands or businesses whose social media and/or Meta ads you have managed, and what you achieved

Your Shopify experience in two or three sentences

The tools you use for scheduling, reporting and task management

title: Experienced SEO Specialist -  ₱68,000/month ($1,100 USD) - Remote Full-Time
description:
We are a private equity-backed organization managing 30+ businesses across healthcare, construction, real estate, consulting, and other industries. Our Philippine-based team includes more than 25 skilled professionals across SEO, content, web development, and digital marketing. We are now looking for an experienced SEO Specialist who can take full ownership of a portfolio of websites and drive measurable growth in organic rankings, traffic, leads, and conversions. Your primary objective will be to help established and newly launched websites rank within the top 3 positions in Google.

This is not a basic SEO role. We need someone who can develop the strategy, determine what needs to be done, execute at a high level, and take responsibility for the results.



MAIN REQUIREMENTS



1. Strong Content Marketing Skills



We believe that high-quality content accounts for a significant portion of SEO success. The right candidate must understand how to plan and create content that satisfies search intent, demonstrates genuine expertise, and performs well in both Google Search and AI-powered search engines. You do not need to be a full-time writer, and you will have access to our in-house content team. 



We are not looking for someone who simply assigns keywords to writers. You must be capable of directing the complete content strategy and ensuring that every page has a clear purpose and a realistic opportunity to rank.



2. Proven Top 3 Position in Google



You must provide verifiable evidence that you have personally helped websites rank within the top 3 organic Google positions for at least 15–20 meaningful and competitive keywords. We regularly receive applications from candidates who can discuss SEO concepts but cannot demonstrate significant ranking results. For this role, actual results are essential.



Your evidence should include:

• Google Search Console screenshots showing improvements in clicks and impressions

• A list of websites you directly optimized

• At least 15–20 keywords that reached Google’s top three organic positions

• The approximate ranking period or timeline

• Your specific responsibilities and the actions you personally implemented

• Supporting screenshots or third-party ranking reports, when available



Important Disclaimer Regarding Results:



The results you submit must be primarily attributable to your own strategy and execution. Please do not present the overall success of a large SEO team if you were only a minor contributor or handled a limited portion of the work.



3. Strong Analytical and Problem-Solving Ability



SEO presents different challenges, and the same strategy will not work in every situation. We need someone who can diagnose problems, identify likely causes, prioritize the right actions, and adjust the strategy based on evidence.

We are not looking for someone who relies on generic SEO checklists. You must be able to investigate each situation using data, form a clear diagnosis, recommend a practical solution, and measure whether your strategy is working.



4. Ownership and Ability to Work Independently



We do not want to micromanage the person in this role. You will be given clear business objectives, target websites, and performance expectations. We are looking for a mature, proactive professional who can work with minimal supervision, take responsibility for decisions, communicate problems early, and remain accountable for results.

If progress slows down, you should investigate why and recommend the next course of action - not wait for someone to tell you what to do.



WHY WORK WITH US?



1. Above-Average Compensation



Earn approximately ₱68,000 per month ($1,100 USD), with opportunities for compensation increases as you deliver measurable results and create greater value for the business.



2. Career Growth



High performers can qualify for faster promotions, salary increases, bonuses, and performance-based incentives. We reward people who consistently create meaningful business impact.



3. Exposure to 27 Businesses



Work across companies in healthcare, construction, real estate, consulting, and other industries. This provides a breadth of SEO and business experience that few professionals have the opportunity to develop.



4. Experienced Digital Leadership



Work alongside leaders with extensive experience in SEO, paid advertising, conversion rate optimization, digital marketing, and business growth.



5. Strong Internal Support



You will have access to in-house writers, developers, and other digital specialists. Although you will own the SEO strategy, you will not be expected to execute every supporting task alone.



6. Fully Remote



Work from anywhere in the Philippines, provided you have a reliable internet connection and can collaborate effectively with our international team.



HOW TO APPLY



 your application to 
 



Please include all of the following:



1. Your updated resume



2.Google Search Console screenshots for the websites you personally optimized, showing graph in organic clicks and impressions



3. For each website you optimized in the past, give a list of at least 15–20 keywords you personally helped rank within the top 3 organic positions on Google



Please do not submit results that primarily came from the work of a larger team unless you clearly disclose your individual contribution.



Applications without verifiable SEO results may not be considered.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a practical SEO assessment before proceeding to the interview stage.

title: Executive Assistant & Social Media Strategist (Part-Time)
description:

What You'll Actually Do



1. Administrative & Logistics Support (top priority, this comes first every day)



Manage the principal's schedule and travel logistics: booking, confirming, and coordinating so they can get to speaking engagements smoothly and on time



Anticipate logistics issues before they become problems (e.g., confirming details ahead of time, double-checking travel/venue arrangements)

Working knowledge of Canva or similar tools, and basic social media scheduling/analytics



Highly organized, reliable, and detail-oriented; this role involves real logistics (travel, deliveries) where mistakes have real consequences



Good written English communication



Comfortable working with a mission-driven/community organization



Design/content creation (Canva, simple graphics/captions) is part of the job



Bonus



Experience supporting a public figure, speaker, or thought leader



Experience with
/Instagram Ads



Copywriting/storytelling background



Familiarity with scheduling tools (Buffer, Later, Meta Business Suite, calendar/travel tools, etc.)







How to Apply Please send:

title: Event Operations Coordinator for Fast-Growing Australian Events Company
description:
How to apply — mandatory requirements



Two things are required from every applicant. No exceptions.

- A 3-minute Loom video. Introduce yourself, walk through your relevant coordination or events experience. Please speak naturally and DO NOT read from a script.

- Submit an updated CV in a PDF format



Applications missing either the Loom video or the CV will NOT be considered.



Summary

We're a recruitment partner hiring for an established Australian company that runs large-scale public food and lifestyle events. Each event runs across multiple days with 20–25+ vendors, a full marketing campaign, and a long list of suppliers to book and confirm. They run on a repeating monthly cycle, which means there is always one event in delivery and another in build.



We need a remote Event Operations Coordinator to own the moving parts from the moment an event is confirmed through to post-event close-out.



This is a coordination and execution role, not a creative or strategy role. You won't be d
 the event theme, the commercial model or which vendors get accepted. You will be the person who makes sure everything that was d
 actually happens, on time.



What you'll be doing

- Running the master event tracker — setting each event up, calculating task due dates from the event date, assigning tasks, checking daily, chasing what's overdue

- Sending a structured end-of-day report so management can see an event's status without opening the tracker

- Vendor administration across 20–25+ vendors per event: contracts, signatures, food safety certificates, public liability insurance, stall size, power requirements, commission arrangements, contact and social media records

- Vendor communication: welcome packs, marketing requirements, bump-in details, final briefings, one-week-out reminders, and answering routine questions from approved information

- Tracking vendor marketing compliance — required posts, countdown banners, event shares — and chasing before every posting deadline

- Coordinating content creators and influencers: briefs, shoot dates, attendance, deliverables, chasing content and saving links

- Running influencer night logistics, voucher printing and distribution, and food send-outs

-
 (Klaviyo or similar) and SMS campaigns: briefing design, testing links, scheduling, recording open and click performance

- Updating the event website in WordPress/Elementor each cycle — dates, venue, map, parking, FAQs, vendor lineup, competition, images — and testing every link on desktop and mobile

-
 Event setup, social bios and pinned flyers across Instagram and TikTok

- Local outreach: community businesses, universities and TAFEs, flyer and banner distribution, local media and council invitations

- QR code and lead capture campaigns: landing page, signage, onsite testing, tagging leads by event

- Supplier and infrastructure bookings: power, cool rooms, equipment hire, barriers and lighting, cleaning and waste, security — booking, confirming, and following up delivery and collection

- Building the multi-day event run sheet and confirming every arrival time, shift and delivery against it

- Vendor commissions, reconciliation, and the final post-event report



What we're looking for

- Experience coordinating events, projects or operations remotely. Events experience is a strong bonus, but disciplined project coordination in any industry is highly regarded

- You are relentless about following up. A large part of this role is chasing people who haven't replied — politely, repeatedly, without being asked to

- Strongly detail-oriented, with a habit of recording proof rather than just marking things done

- Hands-on with WordPress and Elementor, or able to demonstrate you can learn it quickly — you'll be editing event pages yourself, not raising tickets

- Confident with task management tools, spreadsheets,
 marketing platforms and social scheduling

- Clear, professional written English — you'll be the main point of contact for dozens of vendors and suppliers

- Good judgement about what you handle yourself versus what you escalate

- Able to hold a lot of concurrent deadlines across two overlapping event cycles without dropping any



What success looks like:

- You've run at least one full event cycle end to end, from confirmation to close-out

- The tracker is current every working day and nothing sits overdue without being flagged

- Vendor compliance documents are collected ahead of deadline rather than chased in the final week

- The end-of-day report is running consistently and management is relying on it

- A complete post-event report has been delivered covering attendance, vendor sales, marketing performance and key learnings

title: E-Commerce Product Research VA – Meta Ads Library / Dropshipping
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented Product Research Virtual Assistant to help us discover and research potential products for our e-commerce brands.



Your main job will be to research products and brands using the Meta/Facebook Ads Library, identify products that are already being successfully advertised, and organize your findings in a Google Sheet.



This is not a basic “find trending products on AliExpress” role. We are looking for someone who enjoys digging deeper, comparing competitors and markets, and finding useful information.



What you'll do

Research DTC/e-commerce brands and products using Meta Ads Library

Find products that have strong evidence of being actively advertised/scaled

Check how many active ads brands are running and in which countries

Research whether other brands are selling/advertising the same or similar product

Look for potential market gaps between Sweden, Norway, USA and the UK

Find the same/similar products on AliExpress, Alibaba or other supplier platforms and estimate product cost

Record competitor pricing, product links, ad library links and other relevant information

If you have access to TikTok, occasionally check products there for additional validation

Organize all research clearly in a provided Google Sheet



We will provide the research template, keywords, examples, and instructions.



What kind of products are we looking for?



Generally, we are looking for evergreen physical products that:



Sell for approximately $19–$60 (sometimes up to ~$100)

Can realistically be sourced from China

Have healthy potential margins

Have an emotional/problem-solving angle

Are already being successfully advertised by one or more e-commerce brands

Can potentially be introduced into a market where competition is lower



We are not looking for major mainstream brands such as Nike, Coca-Cola, H&M, Zalando, etc., or random seasonal/gimmicky products.



Who we're looking for



You may be a good fit if you:



Have experience with e-commerce, dropshipping or product research

Know how to use Meta/Facebook Ads Library

Are good at online research and finding information independently

Can distinguish a real DTC/e-commerce brand from a major retailer or mainstream brand

Are comfortable comparing products and competitors across different countries

Have strong attention to detail

Can follow a process and enter information accurately into Google Sheets

Have good written English

Don't just fill spreadsheets — you actually investigate what you find



Experience with AliExpress/Alibaba, TikTok research, Shopify stores or competitor research is a plus.



How to apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Tell me about any previous e-commerce/product research experience you have.

2. Have you used Meta Ads Library for product or competitor research before? If yes, explain briefly how.

3. What tools/websites do you normally use for e-commerce product research?

4. If you found a product with 150 active ads in the US but almost no advertisers selling the same product in Sweden, what would that tell you?

5. Start your application with the word “RESEARCH” so I know you read the full job post.



There will be a small paid test task before hiring.



Pay: $4–5 USD/hour depending on experience

Hours: 2–4 hours/day for an initial 1–2 week project

Potential for ongoing work if you're good at finding products

title: Real Estate Cold Caller / Acquisitions VA — California Wholesaling (2-Min Voice Sample Required)
description:
We're a real estate wholesaling operation focused on California properties, looking for an experienced cold caller and lead qualifier — not a script reader. We'd rather pay top-of-range for someone genuinely persuasive than bottom-of-range for someone who reads lines. You'll be calling both cold lists and warm leads (motivated sellers of houses and land in CA), roughly 20 hours per week to start, with room to grow. Your job is to build rapport, uncover motivation, and pre-qualify.

We provide the dialer, CRM, lead lists, and call framework — you bring the skill.

How hiring works: We start with a paid one-week trial (10 hours) at your quoted rate. Top performers move to ~20 hrs/week ongoing. Payment weekly via Upwork.

On every call you'll dig into:



Property condition (repairs needed, occupancy, roof/HVAC/foundation, etc.)

Seller motivation — why they're selling and how fast they need to close

Price flexibility — whether the seller is open to a below-market cash offer, and getting a ballpark number

Timeline and situation (foreclosure, inheritance, tired landlord, vacancy, insurance/wildfire issues, etc.)



Every qualified lead gets logged with detailed notes. Extra-warm/hot sellers (motivated, flexible on price, ready to move) get escalated same-day — so your notes and your read on the seller need to be sharp. Lead accuracy is what we measure; inflated grading doesn't work here.

Compliance is non-negotiable: All lists are scrubbed against the National Do Not Call Registry before every campaign — you never dial an unscrubbed number. Every call opens with a recording disclosure ("this call may be recorded") per California law. Calls happen within legal Pacific Time calling windows. If you're experienced with US calling, none of this will be new to you.

Requirements:



Proven experience cold calling for US real estate wholesaling or investing (not entry-level — you should already know motivated seller, ARV, cash offer, assignment)

Fluent, natural, warm-sounding English that a distressed American homeowner would feel comfortable talking to — this matters more to us than years of experience

Strong rapport and objection handling — you can keep a seller on the phone after "I'm not interested"

Familiarity with TCPA/DNC compliance and comfortable giving recording disclosures on every call

California market familiarity is a strong plus (property taxes, inherited properties, insurance costs)

Self-sufficient with dialers and CRMs; minimal hand-holding needed

Available ~20 hrs/week during Pacific Time calling windows

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, quality headset



TO APPLY — Applications missing the voice recording won't be considered:



Attach a voice recording of at least 2 minutes — ideally a real (redacted) cold call; otherwise a mock cold call to a distressed seller: introduce yourself, give a recording disclosure, probe property condition, uncover motivation, and handle at least one objection.

How long have you cold called for US real estate specifically, and for what type of investor? Any California experience?

Which dialer(s) and CRM(s) have you personally used?

A seller says: "I'd sell, but not for some lowball offer." Write out exactly what you'd say next.

In 2–3 sentences: how do you decide a lead is hot and worth escalating same-day versus just "qualified"?

Your requested hourly rate, and one sentence on what experience justifies it.

title: Social Media Content Designer & Short-Form Video Editor | Long-Term Role
description:
We’re a boutique Australian social media agency looking for a talented Social Media Content Designer & Short-Form Video Editor to join our growing team on a long-term, part-time basis.



This is not a general VA role.



We’re looking for someone who genuinely loves the creative side of social media. Someone with a strong eye for design, who understands what makes short-form video engaging, and can take an approved content brief and turn it into polished, on-brand content without needing constant direction.



You’ll be working across established Australian service and lifestyle brands in industries including jewellery, health and wellness, home improvement and professional services.



We have high creative standards, but we also value efficiency. Great work matters, but we don’t believe every carousel needs hours of unnecessary tweaking.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



Your main responsibilities will include:



Designing Instagram carousels and social media graphics in Canva

Editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

Turning raw footage into polished, engaging social content

Adding text overlays, captions, B-roll, music and sound where appropriate

Creating Reel covers and supporting social media assets

Working from established brand guidelines, templates, copy and content briefs

Sourcing suitable imagery and visual assets where required

Identifying emerging short-form video formats and creative trends

Suggesting creative Reel and video concepts that could be adapted for individual clients

Contributing ideas for content shoots, B-roll and video execution

Keeping up with changes in short-form video, editing styles and social media creative



We don’t blindly follow trends. Strategy and messaging come first.



But we do want someone who understands what’s happening creatively on Instagram and TikTok and can identify opportunities that make sense for a specific brand.



YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU

Have professional experience creating social media content

Have a strong portfolio showing BOTH social media design and short-form video editing

Are highly skilled in Canva

Are confident using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar editing software

Understand Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

Have a strong understanding of hooks, pacing and viewer retention

Understand typography, hierarchy, spacing and composition

Can follow established brand guidelines closely

Can work across multiple brands without making them all look the same

Have excellent attention to detail

Work efficiently and make strong creative decisions without endlessly tweaking

Communicate clearly and reliably

Can manage deadlines without being chased

Take feedback well and apply it to future work

Can work independently without constant supervision



Experience working with Australian, UK, US or other international brands is highly regarded.



WHAT WE’RE NOT LOOKING FOR



We’re not looking for someone who simply drops text into a Canva template.



We’re not looking for overly flashy editing for the sake of it.



We’re not looking for someone who blindly copies whatever is trending.



We’re not looking for someone who needs every creative decision explained to them.



And we’re not looking for someone who produces beautiful work but takes an excessive amount of time to create it.



We care about quality, creative judgement, attention to detail and efficiency.



Our clients trust us with their brands, so the standard of the work matters.



ABOUT ANDREA MAREE CREATIVE



Andrea Maree Creative is a boutique, strategy-led Australian social media agency.



We help established service and lifestyle brands build a premium social media presence that strengthens their positioning, builds trust and generates qualified enquiries.



Our approach is strategy first, aesthetics always.



We’re a small, collaborative team and we’re looking for someone who wants to become an important part of that team long term.



HOURS & PAY



This will begin as a part-time freelance/contractor position, with the opportunity for hours to increase as the agency grows.



We’re looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship, not a short-term project.



Starting rate: AUD $16–$22 per hour, depending on experience, portfolio quality, efficiency and skill level.



We’re happy to pay towards the higher end of the range for someone who is highly skilled, efficient and can work autonomously.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself.

A link to your portfolio, including examples of BOTH social media graphic/carousel design and short-form video editing.

One short-form video from your portfolio that you’re particularly proud of. Tell us what you personally did on the project, one creative decision you made intentionally, and what you would change if you edited it again today.

Approximately how long you would expect to spend designing a 6–8 slide Instagram carousel when the copy, content brief and brand guidelines are already provided.

The software you use for graphic design and short-form video editing.

Your current hourly rate in AUD or PHP.

Your current weekly availability.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid creative trial using a real-world style brief similar to the work you would complete with us. Please include “I pay close attention to detail” in the subject line of your application.



We’re looking for someone talented, reliable and genuinely creative who wants to grow with our team long term.

title: Senior Email Marketing Specialist (Customer.io Expert)
description:
About Dreambound



Dreambound helps people in the US find and enroll in career training programs, from healthcare to trades to tech. Email is one of our revenue channels, and we're investing in taking it to the next level.



About the Role



We're looking for a senior email marketing specialist to strengthen and scale our email program. You'll work inside 
, running lifecycle campaigns and daily broadcasts to an engaged US audience, with revenue tracked end to end through our affiliate platform (Everflow).



This is a hands-on expert role. You'll be trusted with real revenue responsibility: our goal is to grow email revenue roughly 10% month over month while keeping our sender reputation healthy. You should be the kind of person who spots a deliverability dip before anyone else does and already has a fix in motion. You will work closely with our EM team that will help you execute your strategies.



What You'll Do



*Lifecycle campaigns

     - Build, QA, and run automated campaigns around the lead journey (form funnel follow-ups, application nudges, re-engagement, rejection flows)

     - Verify enrollments, segments, and trigger events are firing correctly, and catch silent exclusions before they cost revenue

     - Build tracking links from scratch in Everflow with correct parameters so every click and conversion attributes accurately



*Testing and optimization

     - Keep at least one A/B test live on every active campaign, one element at a time, resolved cleanly

     - Match the metric to the test: subject lines to open rate, CTAs to click rate, everything ultimately to revenue

     - Use daily broadcasts as your idea lab, then promote winners into campaigns



*Deliverability and metrics

     - Own deliverability: Google Postmaster Tools, 
 deliverability tab, list hygiene, engagement filters, sunset policies

     - Hold our target thresholds on every send (delivered above 98%, open above 25%, click above 2%, unsub below 0.2%, hard bounce below 0.5%, spam below 0.08%)



*Communication

     - Flag issues early with a proposed solution, confirm task understanding in your own words, follow through same-day

     - Study competitor email programs and bring the strongest ideas back



What We're Looking For



*Must-haves

     - 4+ years in lifecycle/email marketing with direct revenue accountability, ideally in lead generation, affiliate, edtech, or another performance-driven vertical

     - Expert-level experience in 
 (or deep experience in Iterable, Braze, or Klaviyo with proven ability to switch): segments, event-triggered journeys, Liquid personalization, conversion goals, webhooks

     - Proven deliverability recovery experience: you can walk us through a time you took a domain from Medium/Low reputation back to healthy, and explain the levers you pulled (volume throttling, engaged-only sending, list pruning, warm-up)

     - Fluent in email authentication and infrastructure: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, one-click unsubscribe, and the current Gmail/Yahoo bulk sender requirements

     - Strong list hygiene instincts: sunset policies, engagement tiering, re-permission campaigns, suppression management, bounce classification (hard vs soft, and what to do with each)

     - Disciplined experimenter: single-variable A/B tests, correct metric per test, statistical patience, clean resolution, documented learnings

     - Sharp direct-response copywriting: subject lines, preview text, CTAs that get clicked by a US consumer audience

     - Data fluency: you can pull your own numbers, separate machine opens from human opens, calculate revenue per send/click, and spot when a metric shift is a tracking bug vs a real change

     - Excellent written English and same-day communication habits



*Strong pluses

     - Affiliate/performance tracking platforms (Everflow): building links, sub-ID structure, postback/pixel debugging

     - US compliance awareness: CAN-SPAM, TCPA sensitivity around consumer lead gen, and how compliance shapes what we can send

     - Hands-on HTML email skills (MJML or raw HTML/CSS) and rendering QA across clients (Litmus, Email on 
 or manual device testing)

     - Inbox placement and seed testing tools (GlockApps, Inbox Monster, or similar) and Google Postmaster Tools monitoring

     - Send-time optimization, frequency capping strategy, and preference centers

     - Experience emailing large consumer lists (100k+) where reputation mistakes are expensive

     - SQL or comfort querying data directly, and using AI tools to speed up drafting and analysis

     - Competitor teardown habit: you subscribe to rival programs and reverse-engineer what works

title: Social Media & Content VA – Beauty Brand
description:
We’re an Australian e-commerce beauty brand looking for a creative and reliable Content Virtual Assistant to work with us on an ongoing, part-time basis.



We’re looking for someone with a strong eye for beauty, skincare and cosmetics content who can take our ideas, inspiration and existing content library and turn them into polished, on-brand content.



A big part of this role will be taking inspiration we send you and adapting it for our brand. For example, we may send you a trending Instagram carousel and say, “We love this concept – can you create our own version for our brand?”



You should be comfortable understanding the concept, going through our shared content library to find relevant product photography, UGC, before & after results, customer reviews and other assets, and then creating an original version that fits our brand.



We’ll also work together on an ongoing content list, with pieces for you to create each week. This may include:



Instagram carousels and static posts

Instagram Stories

Lash and brow before & after/result content

Customer review and testimonial graphics

Product education and benefit content

Promotional, sale and launch content

EDM/email marketing content and graphics

Repurposing existing UGC and creator content

Adapting trending social media concepts for our brand

Selecting appropriate imagery and assets from our shared Google Drive

Building and organising a bank of ready-to-use content



We’re looking for someone with an excellent understanding of beauty aesthetics. Our brand style is clean, modern and elevated, so previous experience creating content for beauty, skincare, cosmetics, fashion or similar brands is highly preferred.



Experience with Canva or other professional design/editing software is required. Canva experience is highly preferred as we currently use Canva for many of our brand assets and templates, however, we’re open to other programs if you have a workflow that allows for easy collaboration, editing and file sharing.



You should be able to look at a piece of inspiration and understand why the content works, rather than simply copying the design.



You’ll be a great fit if you have a strong creative eye, understand current social media content styles, can work independently from a concept or reference, are confident selecting appropriate assets from a shared library, have good written English and excellent attention to detail, and are reliable and easy to communicate with.



Experience with EDMs/email marketing and e-commerce brands is a big bonus.



We are not looking for someone to completely manage our social media or develop our entire marketing strategy. We know our brand and will work collaboratively with you on ideas and what we want created. We’re looking for someone who can take those ideas and execute them beautifully and consistently without needing every detail mapped out for them.



This will initially be approximately 5–10 hours per week, with the opportunity for more hours and long-term ongoing work if we work well together. We are based in Australia, but you do not need to work Australian business hours.



To apply, please include:



A short introduction about yourself and your experience.

Your hourly rate in USD.

A link to your portfolio or examples of work you have personally created.

Examples of beauty, skincare, cosmetics or e-commerce content you've created, if available.

Examples of carousels, Stories and EDM/email designs, if available.

What programs you use to create content and why you prefer them.

Any beauty/e-commerce brands you've previously worked with.



Please start your application with the word BLOOMED so we know you've read the full job description.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid creative trial using assets supplied by our brand.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About Us



Dreambound is a mission-driven education startup. We help Americans find purposeful work by connecting people with training programs, from trade schools to colleges, that help them build better careers. We’re a fast-growing company (4x last year), backed by top investors like Union Square Ventures and Arrive (Roc Nation).



About the Role



We’re looking for a full-time Social Media Manager to run Dreambound's day-to-day social presence across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and
. We set the strategy and hand you the briefs, then you turn them into a steady flow of content: planning the calendar, publishing, keeping the editor moving, and growing our visibility socially. You also keep an eye on what's working to help shape what we make next. You live and breathe social. You know what’s trending, why things get net positive attention, and how to turn that into a plan the team can execute. As we scale, there's room to grow into owning organic social end-to-end.



What You’ll Be Doing



- Briefing: Take our creative briefs and direction and turn them into clear, specific asks for the video editor/designer. 

- Publishing: Schedule, publish, and manage day-to-day posting across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and
.

- Community: Engage the audience, monitor comments and DMs, and grow the community.

- Copywriting: Write captions, hooks, and on-screen text tailored to each platform.

- Trend Spotting: Stay ahead of platform trends and surface fresh ideas for the team to green-light.

- Collaboration: Work closely with the video editor/designer to keep output on schedule and on-brand.



You’re the Right Fit If



- You can work U.S. PST hours.

- You are a Social-Media Native: You know what’s trending, you know why certain videos go viral, and you can replicate that “feeling” in your work.

- You’re a Visual Problem Solver: You can take a text-based brief and instantly see the visual story in your head.

- You Balance Speed and Quality: You thrive in a startup environment where we move fast, but you never sacrifice the brand’s look and feel.

- You have the “Knack”: You have an intuitive sense for layout, typography, and pacing.

- You’re a strong writer who can craft scroll-stopping captions and hooks.

- You can translate creative strategy briefs into clear ideas that a creative team can execute on.



Experience



- Mid-level social media management experience

- A track record of growing social accounts not just editing good and posting daily



Nice to Have



- A good know-how of reporting the necessary metrics, so you can see what’s working. 

- Comfort using AI tools in your content, reporting, and/or overall workflow. 



What We Provide



- The strategy, direction, and brand guidelines.

- A dedicated video editor/designer to produce the content.

- A collaborative startup environment where your work directly impacts growth.



What We Offer (Full-Time)



- Competitive salary (negotiable by experience)

- 13th-month pay, internet allowance, U.S. holiday leave

- HMO, PhilHealth, SSS, Pag-Ibig after probation

- Paid sick leave and time-off

- Pay increase possible after 6-month probation based on performance



To Apply



Please use the code DreamTeam when applying. Submit your resume, a short note on your approach to social media, and examples of accounts or campaigns you’ve managed (with results, if you have them).

title: Recruitment Delivery Manager — US Direct-Hire Staffing — Night Shift, Remote
description:
Type of Work: Full-time | Hours: 40/week | Shift: Fixed US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri

Compensation: $1,200–$2,000/month base + placement-linked bonus

Company: Talent Staffing and Recruiting — a US-based direct-hire staffing firm focused on healthcare/allied-health, expanding into new verticals



JOB OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Recruitment Delivery Manager — a player-coach who owns our open-job board end-to-end and is accountable for filling it. Fully remote, Philippines-based, reporting directly to the founder.



This is not a sourcing-team or coordinator seat. You take the list of open US jobs, build the fill strategy for each one (sourcing channels, candidate pool, pay-band reality, timeline), personally recruit on the priority searches — sourcing, screening, and submitting candidates yourself — and build and coach a small delivery team as volume grows. You own the number: qualified submittals per week and jobs filled.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Own the open-req board: triage every US job, build a written per-req fill strategy, and keep every req moving or call it honestly.

Personally work the priority desks full-cycle: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit qualified candidates to US clients.

Drive the delivery standard — quality-gated submittals per recruiter per week — with every candidate recruiter-screened before submission, no resume-blasting.

Recruit, onboard, and coach delivery recruiters as the board requires; run the daily delivery cadence and report fill metrics weekly to the founder.

Tell the truth with numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills — measured, never estimated.



REQUIRED



4+ years US staffing/recruiting delivery experience, including 2+ years leading a delivery team measured on submittals and placements (not a sourcing-only or admin team). US healthcare staffing strongly preferred; allied health/imaging a major plus.

Placements you personally closed — you can name specific placements you made (role, US state, salary) and walk through how you filled them. There will be a detailed walkthrough in the interview.

Tenure that holds: at least one 24+ month run at a single staffing employer.

Excellent spoken English — you'll screen candidates by phone and coach people who do; there's a live spoken check.

Fluent with an ATS and modern sourcing (job boards, LinkedIn, licensure/credential basics for US healthcare roles).

Can work the fixed US night shift long-term with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).



Do NOT apply if:



Your leadership experience is sourcing/CV-mining teams only (you've never owned submittals-to-fill).

You've only coordinated VMS portals or onboarding paperwork.

You cannot name specific placements you personally closed.

Your spoken English isn't strong enough to screen US healthcare professionals, or you can't commit to the fixed US night shift.



Why us: You run the whole delivery engine, not a slice of it — direct line to the founder, real authority over strategy and (as volume grows) your own team, competitive base plus a placement-linked bonus so your fills pay you, fully remote, long-term.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



The delivery team you led: company, your title, team headcount, what the team was measured on, and its typical submittals + placements per month. What part did you personally still recruit on?

Name ONE placement you personally closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you found the candidate. (Most important question — real specifics; we verify on the call.)

Your longest single tenure at one staffing employer: company + number of months.

title: Wedding Video Editor
description:
Edit wedding films that match our current style. Blake’s Films is looking for a talented and detail-oriented Wedding Film Editor to join our team. This role is ideal for someone who has a strong understanding of cinematic wedding films and is highly proficient in DaVinci Resolve.



The goal of this position is not simply to create a good wedding film — it’s to learn and consistently reproduce the Blake’s Films editing, storytelling, and color-grading style.



Responsibilities



* Edit cinematic wedding films from start to finish in DaVinci Resolve

* Organize and manage large amounts of wedding footage efficiently

* Build emotional, intentional stories that reflect the couple and their wedding day

* Select strong moments, dialogue, audio, and music to create compelling edits

* Match the established Blake’s Films editing style

* Learn and accurately replicate our color-grading style, including skin tones, exposure, contrast, and overall film look

* Maintain consistent color and visual quality across an entire wedding film

* Perform professional audio editing, mixing, and basic sound design

* Incorporate speeches, vows, ceremony audio, and natural audio into the story

* Take direction and implement feedback quickly and accurately

* Communicate clearly throughout the editing process

* Meet agreed-upon deadlines and maintain consistent turnaround times

* Maintain organized project files and timelines



Requirements



* Advanced proficiency in DaVinci Resolve

* Strong understanding of professional video editing and color grading

* Experience editing wedding films or other cinematic/event films

* Strong storytelling instincts and attention to emotional detail

* Ability to match an existing editing and color-grading style rather than relying solely on your own style

* Strong understanding of skin tones, exposure, color balance, and cinematic grading

* Excellent attention to detail

* Ability to receive constructive feedback and make revisions

* Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills

* Reliable, organized, and able to meet deadlines

* Able to work independently with minimal supervision



What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who is creative but coachable.



You should have your own editing experience and a strong eye for storytelling, but you also need to be willing to put your personal style aside when necessary and learn the Blake’s Films look and workflow.



We will provide examples, references, and direction so you can learn exactly how we want our films to feel, flow, and look. Over time, you should be able to take raw footage and deliver an edit that feels like it was edited in-house by Blake’s Films.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal editor:



* Has a strong cinematic eye

* Understands emotional storytelling

* Is highly experienced in DaVinci Resolve

* Has a strong understanding of color grading

* Can closely replicate a reference edit and color grade

* Pays attention to small details

* Communicates clearly in English

* Takes feedback well

* Is dependable and deadline-oriented

* Wants a long-term working relationship rather than a one-off project

title: Graphic Designer – AI Image Editing & Product Packaging (Part-Time)
description:
We are a fast-growing e-commerce brand looking for a creative and experienced Graphic Designer to join our team on a part-time basis.



We are looking for someone who is very good at creating realistic, high-quality images with AI and turning them into professional designs for our website, product pages, advertisements, banners, packaging, and other marketing materials.



For most of our day-to-day design and editing work, we prefer to work in Canva where possible. You should therefore be very comfortable and efficient with Canva. Photoshop or other professional editing software can also be used when needed.



A big part of this role is combining strong graphic design skills with the latest AI image-generation tools.



AI IMAGE CREATION



You should be very comfortable creating high-quality and realistic images using tools such as:



* ChatGPT Pro image generation

* Nano Banana Pro

* Higgsfield

* Other professional AI image-generation tools



We especially care about realism and product accuracy.



You should understand how to properly prompt and work with reference images to create the exact type of image we need.



For example, you should be able to:



* Create realistic people naturally using or holding our products

* Create realistic lifestyle scenes around our products

* Create professional close-up product images

* Create premium studio-style product photography

* Make our products look high-end and professionally photographed

* Place our actual products realistically into AI-generated environments

* Maintain the correct product shape, packaging, colors, branding, and labels

* Create different camera angles and compositions from product references

* Create realistic close-ups of people, hands, faces, products, and product usage

* Control lighting, shadows, reflections, depth of field, and camera perspective

* Create images that look like real commercial photography rather than obvious AI

* Use prompting and reference images to maintain consistency between different images



We are not looking for someone who simply types a basic prompt and selects the first image.



You should understand how to build and refine prompts, use references correctly, iterate on generations, and recognize what needs to be changed to achieve a professional result.



The goal is to create images that could realistically have come from a professional e-commerce or product photoshoot.



CANVA & GRAPHIC DESIGN



After creating the images, you will often turn them into finished designs in Canva.



We prefer Canva for much of our regular creative work because it allows our team to easily access, edit, duplicate, and reuse designs.



Your work can include:



* Website images

* Homepage banners

* Product page images

* Landing page graphics

* Advertising creatives

* Promotional banners

* Lifestyle product images

* Product benefit graphics

* Comparison graphics

* Offer and sale creatives

*
 graphics

* Social media creatives

* Product mockups

* Other e-commerce marketing materials



You should have a strong eye for layout, typography, spacing, composition, colors, and branding.



You should be comfortable combining AI-generated imagery, real product assets, text, icons, graphics, and other elements into professional finished creatives.



Canva will be our preferred software for many of these tasks. Photoshop or other professional design software can be used for more advanced editing when necessary.



PRODUCT PACKAGING DESIGN



Another important part of the role will be helping us create and update packaging for our products.



This can include:



* Product boxes

* Pouches

* Labels

* Sachets

* Bottles and containers

* Product inserts

* Packaging mockups

* New product packaging



We already have an established brand and existing product packaging.



When we create a new product, the packaging should look like it belongs to the same brand and product family.



You should be able to study our existing designs and maintain consistency across colors, fonts, typography, icons, layout, spacing, product presentation, and overall visual identity.



You may also receive packaging dielines or templates from manufacturers that need to be adapted into final packaging designs.



EXPERIENCE WE REQUIRE



This is not an entry-level position.



You should already have experience using professional graphic design and AI image-generation software and have previous experience creating designs for brands, e-commerce businesses, agencies, or similar companies.



We are looking for someone with:



* Previous professional graphic design experience

* Previous experience working with brands

* Strong Canva experience

* Experience with Photoshop or similar professional editing software

* Strong experience with AI image-generation software

* Strong prompting skills

* Experience working with reference images

* Ability to create realistic AI product photography

* Ability to create realistic people using products

* Experience creating website and e-commerce graphics

* Experience creating banners and advertising creatives

* Experience maintaining an established brand identity

* Experience with product packaging or label design

* Good understanding of typography and layout

* Good understanding of e-commerce design

* Strong attention to detail

* Good English communication

* Ability to work independently



Experience working specifically with e-commerce or DTC brands is a big advantage.



HOW WE WORK



Sometimes we will give you a detailed brief with exactly what we want.



Other times, we may send you an existing design, competitor example, product photo, reference image, or rough idea and ask you to turn it into something that fits our brand.



You should be able to understand the idea and execute it without needing every individual step explained.



We work quickly and regularly need new website images, advertisements, banners, product images, and other creatives.



Over time, we want you to become very familiar with our brand so you can immediately recognize what fits our visual identity.



This is a part-time position, but we are looking for someone for a long-term collaboration. There may also be opportunities for additional hours and responsibilities as we grow.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your experience.

2. A link to your portfolio.

3. Examples of AI images you have created, especially realistic product and lifestyle images.

4. Your expected hourly rate in PHP.

5. How many hours per week you are available to work.



At the beginning of your application, write "AI DESIGN" so we know you have read the full job description.



Please do not apply if your experience is limited to basic Canva templates or basic AI image generation.



We are looking for an experienced designer who knows how to combine AI image creation, prompting, Canva, and professional graphic design to create realistic, premium, on-brand content.



If you have experience working with brands, have a strong visual eye, and are genuinely skilled with modern AI image-generation tools, we would love to see your portfolio.
