title: Performance Marketing Manager (Google Ads & Meta Ads)
description:
ABOUT US



We're NH Repairs, a commercial truck, trailer, fleet, and RV repair business in South Florida. We spend real money on paid ads and we're looking for someone to own our entire digital customer acquisition. Not someone who just logs into Google Ads, adjusts bids, and reports on impressions. We want someone who brings in real paying customers.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



From day one, you'll manage our Google Ads and Meta 
/Instagram) advertising, including:



*Google Search campaigns and Performance Max

*Keyword and search-term analysis, negative keyword management

*Geographic targeting and campaign structure

*Ad copy, offers, and A/B testing

*Conversion tracking, call tracking, GA4 and GTM

*Meta and Instagram ads and retargeting

*Landing page testing and optimization

*Competitor research

*Reporting on qualified leads and cost per qualified lead



As you settle in, this grows to include building new landing pages, AI-assisted website and ad creative, lead funnels, CRM integrations, and conversion rate optimization.



You don't need to be a developer, but you do need to be comfortable with landing page builders, WordPress or similar, and modern AI tools, enough to build and improve pages without needing a developer for every small change.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



We do not care about impressions, clicks, CTR, or Google's optimization score. We measure success by qualified phone calls, qualified service requests, cost per qualified lead, estimates generated, jobs sold, revenue, and gross profit. Our best customers are local businesses and fleets running trucks, trailers, commercial vehicles, or equipment.



REQUIREMENTS (you should apply if you)



Have strong hands-on Google Ads experience

Have managed meaningful monthly ad spend across both Google and Meta

Understand Google Search and Performance Max deeply, and know when to use each

Understand conversion tracking and attribution

Can diagnose weak campaign performance instead of blaming the client or the market

Understand landing page conversion optimization

Use AI tools well

Write and speak excellent English

Are comfortable working with data

Work independently, with minimal supervision

Think commercially: you ask "did this bring in profitable customers," not "did traffic go up"



Bonus: experience with local service businesses (automotive, trucking, repair, home services, medical, or other phone-call-driven businesses).



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



You need daily direction on what to do

You measure your work by clicks, impressions, or traffic

You've only run small campaigns

You can't explain where leads actually come from

You just apply Google's recommendations without questioning them



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words: "Qualified Leads Matter." Applications that skip this won't be reviewed.



We can tell when answers are written with ChatGPT, so instead of typing your answers, please record one Loom video (10 to 15 minutes) where you:



1. Screen-share a real Google Ads and/or Meta account you've managed (blur the client name if needed) and walk through how it's structured.

2. Answer out loud, unscripted: you inherit an account spending $8,000/month for a local service business and leads drop sharply. What are the first five things you check, and how do you tell whether the problem is traffic volume, traffic quality, tracking, the landing page, or the sales team?

3. Talk through Google Search vs Performance Max, when you'd use each, using a real example from your own work.

4. Show one account where you clearly improved performance: actual spend, the problem, what you changed, and before-and-after numbers on screen.

5. List the tools you've actually used for Google Ads, GA4, GTM, call tracking, landing pages, Meta Ads, and AI tools.

6. Walk through how you'd approach your first 30 days managing our account.



Finalists will have a short live call to verify the account work shown in the video. Generic or unverifiable applications will be deprioritized.

title: Online Tutor / Early Childhood Teacher for 4-Year-Old — ₱20,000/Month
description:
# Online Tutor / Early Childhood Teacher for 4-Year-Old — ₱20,000/Month



**Remote | Part-Time | 15 hours/week | Monday–Friday | Long-term**



We are an Australian family looking for a **warm, creative online tutor/teacher for our 4-year-old son**, ideally for at least a year and potentially several years.



This is a one-on-one role with the same child. We want someone who can get to know him well, follow his interests, and create personalised, enjoyable learning rather than simply using worksheets or the same prepared lesson for every student.



## About him



He is 4 years old and has not started formal school yet.



He speaks well once engaged and loves stories and picture books. Some favourites have been **Richard Scarry, Hairy Maclary and Dr. Seuss**.



He is especially interested in:



* cars

* tow trucks and vehicle recoveries

* building and making things

* seeing how machines work

* watching people repair and construct things



We would like his interests to become starting points for learning.



For example, a tow-truck activity might include **reading, counting, drawing, storytelling, simple physics, building something, problem solving, or discussing how someone might think or feel**.



## What we want to teach



The main priority now is **learning to read**, including:



* letters and sounds

* phonemic awareness

* phonics and blending

* early reading

* spelling and writing



Over time, we would also like to introduce:



* maths

* science and basic physics

* biology, health and understanding the body

* emotions and understanding how the mind works

* problem solving and reasoning

* creativity

* building and engineering

* art

* practical life skills

* independence

* general knowledge

* geography

* some history as his interests develop



For example, because he loves cars, history might naturally include **early cars, the Ford Model T, how cars used to be built, and how engines, factories and roads developed**.



We especially want to develop skills such as **problem solving, creativity, emotional resilience, curiosity, persistence, flexible thinking, communication and confidence with mistakes**.



## Learning style



We strongly prefer **play-based, hands-on and interest-led learning**.



Even though teaching is online, we do not want him simply watching presentations on a screen.



Activities could include:



* drawing or painting together

* building with cardboard or blocks

* using toy cars

* making signs or maps

* counting physical objects

* simple experiments

* storytelling

* crafts

* solving building or construction problems together



We can prepare materials at home before lessons.



Books, craft supplies and other learning materials will be **paid separately by us**.



## Emotional development



Emotional development is also important.



Like many young children, he can become frustrated when something is difficult or doesn't work as expected.



We are looking for someone who can stay calm and connected, help him understand what he is feeling, work through problems, tolerate mistakes and gradually develop persistence and emotional regulation.



We prefer guidance and support rather than pressure, shame or forced compliance.



## Schedule



**₱20,000 per month for 15 paid hours per week.**



This gives approximately **3 paid hours each weekday**, including both live teaching and preparation/research.



Initially we expect approximately **two short sessions per day**:



* **Morning session:** usually around 25–35 minutes, starting flexibly somewhere between approximately **7:00–9:00 am Philippine time**, depending on his schedule that day.

* **Second session:** usually around **11:00 am Philippine time**, approximately 30–45 minutes.



The second session may be lighter — for example stories, conversation, drawing, building or another enjoyable activity.



At age 4, we do not expect him to sit through long formal lessons. Session length should depend on his attention and engagement.



The remaining paid time can be used for:



* planning activities

* researching things he is currently interested in

* preparing lesson materials

* finding suitable books and resources

* planning his reading development

* thinking of hands-on projects

* keeping simple progress notes

* adapting future lessons based on what works well



As he gets older, more of the 15 hours may gradually shift from preparation into direct teaching.



The exact lesson times can be flexible from day to day.



## Long-term



We are looking for someone who can commit for **at least one year and ideally several years**.



As he gets older, the role may expand in teaching time and responsibility.



Continuity is important to us. We would prefer one teacher who gets to know him very well rather than frequently changing tutors.



## Who we are looking for



Experience with **children aged approximately 3–6** is particularly useful.



Experience in any of these areas is a bonus:



* early-childhood or elementary education

* preschool or kindergarten teaching

* early reading / phonics

* play-based learning

* child development

* creative or project-based learning



Formal qualifications are useful but **not mandatory**.



More important is that you are:



* warm and patient

* creative

* engaging with young children

* excellent at spoken English

* comfortable following a child's interests

* able to improvise when an activity doesn't go as planned

* able to make learning interactive

* comfortable helping a child through frustration

* reliable

* interested in a long-term position



Our son is half Filipino. **Cebuano/Bisaya or Tagalog would be a bonus but is not required.**



# How to apply



Please keep your application simple.



### 1. Brief introduction



Please tell us:



* your experience with children aged 3–6

* any experience teaching early reading or phonics

* any experience with play-based learning

* your education or relevant training

* where in the Philippines you are based

* whether the approximate morning and 11:00 am Philippine-time sessions work for you

* whether you speak Cebuano/Bisaya or Tagalog



### 2. Short 1–2 minute video



Please record a simple video **speaking directly to our son as though you were meeting him for the first time**.



He loves cars, tow trucks, building things and stories.



You might introduce yourself, show him something interesting, ask him a question, or tell him about something you would enjoy reading, making or discovering together.



**Please don't spend significant time preparing or editing the video. A simple phone recording is ideal.**



We mainly want to see your natural spoken English, warmth and way of engaging with a young child.



### 3. Three short questions



**Lesson:**

He is fascinated by tow trucks and vehicle recoveries. What would you do with him for a 20–30 minute lesson?



**Frustration:**

You are building a cardboard vehicle together. It keeps falling apart. He becomes frustrated, pushes it away and says:



**“I can't do it!”**



What would you do next?



**Long-term:**

If you taught him from age 4 until age 6 or 7, how would you hope his learning — and your role — would develop?



**Short answers are completely fine.**



## Selection



We will invite a small number of applicants to a **paid 25–30 minute trial session with our son**.



Experience and qualifications matter, but we are ultimately looking for someone with the right combination of **teaching ability, creativity, patience and a natural connection with him**.

HR & Recruitment Officer



We are looking for a highly organized and proactive HR & Recruitment Officer to support recruitment and general HR operations for a growing education company.



The main focus of this role will be sourcing, screening, and coordinating the hiring process for tutor candidates. The successful candidate will also support employee records, contracts, onboarding, offboarding, leave and absence tracking, payroll coordination, and other day-to-day HR matters.



This role is suitable for someone who works in a structured and organized way, communicates professionally, handles confidential information responsibly, and can manage multiple recruitment and HR tasks independently.



This is a full-time remote position working with an international team.



Responsibilities



Recruitment

, chat, WhatsApp, and other communication channels.

* Maintain an organized recruitment tracking sheet and update each candidate’s recruitment stage.

* Manage a structured recruitment funnel from application and screening through to offer and hiring.

* Support the preparation and communication of job offers and required hiring documents.



HR Administration and Employee Support



* Maintain and organize the employee database, personnel files, contracts, and other HR records.

* Ensure employee information and documentation are accurate, complete, confidential, and up to date.

* Prepare, issue, organize, and track employee contracts, renewals, and other employment-related documents.

* Coordinate offboarding activities, including documentation, handovers, system access removal, and internal communication.

* Maintain accurate leave and absence records, including annual leave, sick leave, unpaid leave, and other approved absences.

* Monitor leave balances and ensure leave requests and absences are properly documented and communicated to relevant team members.

* Support payroll coordination by preparing and sharing accurate HR information, including new hires, salary changes, leave, absences, deductions, bonuses, contract updates, and employee departures.

* Review payroll-related HR data and ensure all required information is submitted accurately and on time.

* Follow up with employees, managers, and relevant team members to resolve missing or incorrect information before payroll deadlines.

* Coordinate HR-related matters between employees, managers, and relevant team members.

* Respond to general employee questions and provide day-to-day HR administrative support.

* Assist with HR policies, employee communications, performance documentation, and other HR processes.

* Support employee engagement, retention, and general team coordination when required.

* Carry out other recruitment, HR, and administrative duties as needed.



Requirements



* Previous experience in recruitment, HR coordination, or HR administration.

* Experience sourcing, screening, and managing candidates through different recruitment stages.

* Experience maintaining employee records and supporting payroll coordination is preferred.

* Familiarity with leave, attendance, or absence tracking is an advantage.

* Strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail.

* Comfortable conducting screening interviews in English.

* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

* Ability to manage multiple candidates, employee records, documents, and deadlines.

* Comfortable handling confidential employee and candidate information.

* Proactive, dependable, and able to work independently without constant supervision.

* Strong follow-up skills and the ability to keep tasks moving.

* Experience working with an international or remote team is an advantage.

* Experience in the education or tutoring industry is an advantage but not required.



Technical Requirements



* Stable and reliable internet connection.

* Quiet and professional remote working environment.

* Comfortable using tools such as:

* Google Sheets and Google Drive

* Zoom or other video conferencing platforms

*
 and calendar tools

* WhatsApp and other messaging platforms

* Job boards and candidate sourcing platforms

* Recruitment tracking systems or spreadsheets

* Employee databases, leave trackers, or HR information systems



Work Schedule



This is a full-time remote position.



Working hours are:



Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Jakarta Time (GMT+7)

10:00 AM to 6:30 PM Philippines Time (GMT+8)



Candidates must be consistently available and fully committed during these working hours.

* Performance bonus for each successful hire, subject to the company’s bonus conditions.



Important

title: Director of Recruiting — US Direct-Hire Staffing — Night Shift, Remote
description:
Type of Work: Full-time, 40 hrs/week



Pay: $2,000–$3,000/mo base + placement-linked bonus 



Schedule: Fixed US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri, long-term



About Us: Talent Staffing and Recruiting is a US-based direct-hire staffing firm focused on healthcare/allied-health placements and expanding into new verticals. 



The Role: We're hiring a Director of Recruiting to own our entire delivery organization. You'll report directly to the founder and be accountable for one number: jobs filled. You inherit a live board of open US roles and a small existing delivery team (including a recruiting manager). You'll set the fill strategy, build the standards and cadence, coach and grow the team — and because we're lean, you'll still personally recruit on our hardest, highest-value searches. As we expand into new verticals, you'll have real ownership over how the delivery org scales, including building out your own team.



Responsibilities



Own the company-wide open-req board: triage every US job, set a written fill strategy per req, and escalate or kill stalled searches honestly.

Lead the delivery org — the recruiting manager and delivery recruiters report to you; run daily cadence, set submittal quality standards, and manage performance.

Personally recruit full-cycle on priority searches: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit.

Build the machine: playbooks, screening gates, KPIs, and a capacity plan; recruit and onboard recruiters as volume grows.

Report weekly to the founder with real numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills.



What You'll Need



6+ years in US staffing/recruiting delivery, including 3+ years leading delivery teams measured on submittals and placements (agency/staffing-firm side, or BPO/RPO delivery centers serving US staffing firms — in-house corporate TA doesn't translate to this role). Experience leading team leads or managers is a strong plus.

US healthcare staffing experience strongly preferred; allied health/imaging is a major plus.

Placements you've personally closed that you can speak to in detail (role, US state, salary, and how you filled them) — this comes up in the interview.

At least one 24+ month tenure at a single staffing employer.

Excellent spoken English — you'll be screening US healthcare professionals and coaching your team.

Comfortable with ATS platforms, modern sourcing, and building (not just reading) a KPI dashboard.

A reliable home setup for a long-term night shift: quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data.



This role probably isn't the right fit if: your leadership background is in-house corporate TA/HR rather than agency delivery, you've led sourcing teams but haven't owned submittals-to-fill accountability, you're not able to speak to specific placements you personally closed, you're a pure people-manager who no longer recruits, or the fixed night shift doesn't work long-term for you.



Why This Role: You'll run the whole delivery organization with a direct line to the founder and real authority over strategy and team build-out. Compensation includes a competitive director-level base plus a bonus tied directly to what your org produces. Fully remote, long-term role with room to grow as we expand.



To Apply, Please Answer:



Tell us about the largest delivery organization you've led: company, your title, headcount and layers (did team leads/managers report to you?), what it was measured on, and typical monthly submittals/placements.

Name one placement you personally closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you sourced the candidate. (We'll dig into specifics on the call.)

What's your longest tenure at a single staffing employer — company and number of months?

Scenario: you inherit ~20 open US direct-hire jobs (mostly healthcare/allied), a recruiting manager, and 2 recruiters, with a ~20% fill rate. In 5–8 sentences, walk us through your first 30 days and the number you'd commit to for day 90.

Can you commit to a fixed US night shift (~9 PM–6 AM PHT), Mon–Fri, long-term? What's your home setup (internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power)?

Current/most recent monthly pay, earliest start date, and a short (30–60 sec) voice intro — introduce yourself as if opening a screening call with a US radiologic technologist.

title: Graphic Designer (Junior - Mid)
description:
Graphic Designer (Junior–Mid) executing across two lanes: packaging and social content.



This is an execution role, not an ideation role. You'll be handed a brief for packaging or a content matrix for social, and your job is to deliver against it with precision, rather than invent the concept.



For packaging, you take the brief and apply real expertise to make the design as good as it can be within it, including catching print and production issues before they become expensive mistakes. We will rely on your expertise to show us the best possible outcome. You have experience with typography, layouts, and working with balancing design elements with open space. 



For social, you will be provided a visual direction to help you work across product launches and week by week content, producing on-brand assets across formats, comfortable with MP4/video content alongside static. 



You need excellent working knowledge of Figma and Adobe suite, a sharp eye for detail (nothing slips through with the wrong crop, wrong colour, wrong file), and the ability to take feedback and suggestions. We are wanting someone who won't need hand-holding, rather than us ask for a fix on a dieline or a note on a social crop, we want you to own this and have confidence so that we don't have to micro manage your output. You are confident in your design work and have incredible attention to detail. You will work closely with our product development team and our creative strategist who will lead the visual direction and ideation for you.

title: Contract UI/UX Designer
description:
CONTRACT UI/UX DESIGNER



ABOUT ESHOPPING GROUP

We're an e-commerce success story with operations across Sydney, Perth, and Brisbane, and an international team of 50+ spanning Australia, US, Philippines, Vietnam, China, and UK. Our portfolio includes seven brands across Beauty, Consumer Electronics, Pets, Surveillance, and Wellness. We operate out of WeWork on Pitt St with a flexible, fast-paced culture that rewards initiative and creativity.



WHY JOIN US?

- International team – collaborate with 50+ people across six countries

- Career growth alignment – we invest in people with vision and ambition

- Expert mentoring – learn from leaders recognised as Top 50 People in Australian ecommerce

- Shared success – your performance directly contributes to business growth



THE ROLE

As we continue to scale multiple brands, we are seeking a Contract UI/UX Designer to join our team part time. This role sits within our in-house creative team and is ideal for a hands-on designer with strong UI/UX and ecommerce experience, who enjoys solving digital problems across multiple brands and turning ideas into intuitive, high-performing experiences.



You'll work closely with our Design & Experience Lead and broader creative, ecommerce, marketing, and product teams, taking ownership of digital projects from brief through to final design and developer handover. You'll also support our CRO program, contributing to research, customer journeys, hypothesis development, and pre- and post-experiment analysis.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- UI/UX Design: Design and improve digital experiences across multiple ecommerce brands, including landing pages, website pages, collection experiences, navigation, and other website enhancements.

- Landing Pages & Website Design: Own projects from brief and initial UX thinking through to wireframes, high-fidelity UI design, prototyping, and developer handover, ensuring solutions are both user-friendly and commercially effective.

- UX & Customer Journeys: Help map customer journeys, identify friction points, and translate user needs and business objectives into clear, intuitive digital experiences.

- CRO Support: Contribute to the CRO program by supporting research, identifying opportunities, developing hypotheses, designing test solutions, and assisting with pre- and post-experiment analysis.

- Design Systems: Work within and contribute to existing design systems and brand guidelines, ensuring consistency while adapting digital experiences to suit different brands and audiences.

- Shopify Design: Design and support front-end improvements across Shopify websites, with a strong understanding of the platform's capabilities and limitations.

- Creative Collaboration: Work closely within the creative team alongside digital designers, graphic designers, copywriters, and content creators to deliver cohesive, high-quality digital experiences.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with marketing, ecommerce, product, development, and data teams to deliver design solutions that balance user needs, brand, and commercial objectives.



REQUIREMENTS

- 2–4 years' experience as a UI/UX or Digital Designer, ideally within e-commerce, agency, or fast-paced digital environments.

- Strong practical experience designing for e-commerce websites, with a portfolio demonstrating real-world website, landing page, and UX work.

- Advanced Figma skills with experience creating wireframes, high-fidelity designs, prototypes, and developer-ready handovers.

- Strong Shopify experience and a solid understanding of working within Shopify's front-end environment.

- Strong understanding of UX principles, information architecture, user journeys, interaction design, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and responsive design.

- Ability to take ownership of a project from brief through to final design and developer handover, while working independently and managing deadlines.

- Comfortable balancing user needs, brand requirements, and commercial objectives when making design decisions.

- Strong communication skills and a collaborative, proactive mindset.

- Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and how front-end designs are implemented is highly beneficial.

- Ability to manage multiple projects, brands, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.



HIGHLY REGARDED

- Experience working within an ecommerce CRO or experimentation program.

- Experience with GA4, Intelligems, Rebuy, or other ecommerce analytics, experimentation, and optimisation tools.

- Experience using customer data, behavioural insights, user research, or analytics to inform design decisions.

- Experience contributing to A/B testing, including hypothesis development, test design, and analysing results.

- Experience creating customer journeys, identifying conversion friction, and developing UX improvements based on data.

- Experience working across multiple brands or sub-brands.

- Experience contributing to or maintaining design systems.

- Experience utilising AI-powered tools to support design, research, ideation, or creative workflows.



BENEFITS

- Competitive remuneration package based on experience

- Professional development and mentoring

- Fast-paced, innovative, and dynamic culture

- Shared success model – your wins are the business's wins



HOW TO APPLY

If this sounds like the role you've been waiting for, we want to meet you! Submit:

- Your CV

- A portfolio showcasing your ecommerce UI/UX, website, landing page, and digital design work

- Please include "eShopping" in the subject line of your application. We can't wait to see your work!

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
(Read entire application before applying, there is information in here that will make or break your application)



Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Position

Salary: $1,000–$2,000 CAD/month



Content Crew is looking for talented Video Editors to join our remote creative team.



We work with entrepreneurs, business owners, coaches, and personal brands to turn raw footage into engaging content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube,
, and LinkedIn.



We're looking for editors who understand that great editing isn't about adding as many effects as possible.



It's about holding attention, telling a story, and making content people actually want to watch.



Compensation & Growth



Starting salary is $1,000 CAD/month, with opportunities to increase your compensation as you grow with the team.



Our Senior Editors currently earn up to $2,000 CAD/month.



We're looking for people who want to stay with Content Crew long-term, continuously improve their skills, take on more responsibility, and grow their compensation along the way.



If you're a great editor, reliable, and consistently produce high-quality work, there is a clear opportunity to progress within our team.



What You'll Be Editing



You'll work on content including:



* Short-form Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts

* Talking-head educational content

* Podcasts and long-form YouTube videos

* Meta/Facebook ads

* Client testimonials and case studies

* Promotional videos

* Personal brand content



What We're Looking For



We're looking for editors with a strong creative eye who understand modern social media content.



You should understand:



* Strong hooks and attention-grabbing openings

* Fast, intentional pacing

* Cutting unnecessary pauses and filler

* B-roll selection and placement

* Music and sound design

* Captions and text animation

* Zooms, punch-ins, and pattern interrupts

* Basic colour correction and audio cleanup

* Editing for viewer retention

* How editing styles should change between organic content, ads, podcasts, and YouTube



CapCut is our preferred editing software, but we're open to editors using other programs if you can produce great work.



We're much more interested in the quality of your edits than what software you use.



You'll Be a Great Fit If You...



* Have a strong sense of pacing and storytelling

* Understand current social media editing styles

* Can take raw footage and make creative decisions independently

* Pay attention to small details

* Communicate well

* Hit deadlines consistently

* Take feedback well

* Can turn around edits quickly

* Want a long-term position with a growing creative team



How Our Hiring Process Works



We want to keep our hiring process simple and fast.



Step 1 — Portfolio + Loom Introduction



To apply, send us your portfolio AND a short Loom video introducing yourself.



We're not looking for a polished or scripted introduction. We just want to get to know the person behind the portfolio.



In your Loom, please answer these four questions:



1. What's your name, age, and location?



2. Tell us a little about yourself.

What do you like doing outside of work? Hobbies, interests, sports, games, travel — whatever you're into.



3. How did you get into video editing?



4. What do you like AND dislike about video editing?



Keep it casual. Just be yourself.



Alongside your Loom, send us a link to your portfolio with examples of your best editing work, especially short-form and social media content.



Step 2 — 24-Hour Editing Test



If we love your portfolio and think you could be a great fit for Content Crew, we'll reach out to arrange a test edit.



We'll send you raw footage and assets, and you'll have 24 hours to turn them into a finished video.



We will only ask you to complete a test edit if we are seriously considering hiring you.



We don't want to waste your time.



If you're receiving a test from us, it means we liked your work, we liked your application, and we believe there's a real possibility of you joining our team.



The test is simply our opportunity to see how you approach our footage, how you make creative decisions, and whether your editing style fits our clients.



Step 3 — Hiring Decision



We move fast.



If we love your test video and think you're a good fit, we'll make our hiring decision the following day.



No weeks of interviews.



No five-round hiring process.



Portfolio + Loom → 24-Hour Test → Hiring Decision



How to Apply



Please send us:



1. Your portfolio

Include your strongest examples of short-form and social media editing.



2. Your Loom introduction

Answer the four questions listed above.



3. Your availability

Let us know whether you're available full-time and when you could start.



4. Your primary editing software

CapCut is preferred, but not required.



Applications without both a portfolio and Loom introduction will not be considered.



We're looking for editors who want to become **long-term members of Content Crew, improve their skills, work on great content, and grow with our team.



If you're confident in your editing and think you'd be a great addition to the crew, send us your portfolio and introduce yourself. We'd love to meet you.

title: Experienced Content Editor (5+ Years in Content Marketing)
description:
180 Marketing is a US-based digital marketing agency looking for an experienced Content Editor to join our team. This is a full-time contractor role for someone based in the Philippines who has spent at least five years working in content marketing, with substantial hands-on writing and editing experience.



CONTENT FORMATS

You should be confident writing and editing all of the following:



• Listicles

• Buyers' guides

• How-to guides

• Product guides

• Best-of articles

• Product reviews

• Product descriptions

• E-commerce category pages

• Service pages

• Press releases



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Edit and proofread content across a range of clients and industries.

• Improve structure, clarity, readability, accuracy, tone, and brand consistency.

• Check facts, sources, grammar, spelling, and formatting before content is delivered.

• Make sure each piece satisfies its brief, search intent, audience, and business purpose.

• Use AI thoughtfully to support research and editing while applying your own judgment and verifying the output.

• Manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines reliably.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• At least five years of experience in a content marketing role.

• Strong professional experience in both content writing and content editing.

• Demonstrated experience across the content formats listed above.

• Exceptional written English and close attention to detail.

• A sound understanding of content strategy, search intent, on-page SEO, and audience needs.

• Practical experience using AI tools in a content workflow.

• Good organization, communication, and reliability.



WORKING CONDITIONS AND BENEFITS



• Full-time contractor role with a US-based company.

• Work during Philippine business hours, for up to seven hours per day.

• No weekend work.

• 10 paid Philippine public holidays.

• 10 days of paid time off each year.

• Annual performance bonus of 5%–9%.

• HMO coverage.

• A ChatGPT Pro account provided by the company.



YOUR APPLICATION MUST CONTAIN



 your resume and a link to a screencast of no more than five minutes to 
 the subject line: Content Editor Application – [Your Name].



In the screencast:



1. Briefly summarize your content marketing experience over the past five years.

2. Show us two pieces of content you have worked on.

3. Explain your contribution to each piece and why you believe it is effective.



You may use a free screen-recording tool such as Loom, ScreenPal, or OBS Studio. Please make sure we can view your links without requesting access.
